izzyondroid:ac.mdiq.Podcini.A.summary: Your premier podcast/media instrument, now extensible, capable of YouTubing
izzyondroid:ac.mdiq.Podcini.A.description:
Podcini.A, an open source extensible media instrument, attuned to Puccini, adorned with pasticcini and aromatized with porcini, invites your harmonious heartbeats.
 Notable features
 Not only handling podcasts, local media, but also any remote media served by external source providers.
 Features multiple, natural and circular play queues associable with any feed.
 Features volume hierarchies each of which can contain sub-volumes and feeds.
 Presents synthetic feeds and allows media to be separately shelved.
 Remote media (unsubscribed) can be reserved or played.
 Allows online search of remote media provided by external sources.
 Enables setting tags, todos, notes/comments, 5-level rating, and 12-level play state on every media.
 Boasts sophisticated sorting, filtering and searching on media and feeds.
 Supports sleep and auto-play timers.
 Presents 2 independent algorithms for auto-download or auto-enqueue specifiable on every feed.
 Supports spaced repetition of repeat media: auto-download or auto-enqueue them at preset intervals specified in the feed.
 Caches streamed audio for seamless local rewind and replay.
 is capable of playing 2 media simultaneously (one in each ear with earphones) with independent controls.
 Features audio clips recording and position marking on any media for better review.
 Allows linking/relating multiple media for better grouping.
 Is capable of preserving important media when a feed is unsubscribed.
 Spotlights sending/receiving feeds and subscriptions catalogue across devices without a server.
 Supports Podcasting 2.0 transcript and captions from external sources
 Offers Readability and Text-to-Speech for RSS contents.
 Supports auto-backups, customized media folder and importing DB from other apps
 Join the Podcini community! 
 Podcini is under active development by volunteers. You can contribute too, with code, comments or improvements. See source code on github.com/XilinJia/Podcini.A

izzyondroid:com.samco.trackandgraph.name: Track & Graph: Habit Tracker
izzyondroid:com.samco.trackandgraph.description:
Track & Graph: Dashboards for life
 Track & Graph helps you record, visualize, and understand patterns in your daily life. Record numerical values or simple occurrences to build personal dashboards that provide insights into your habits, behaviors, and activities.
 Visualize your data through line graphs, pie charts, and statistical reports that show trends, moving averages, and intervals between events. Organize tracking items into customizable groups that make sense for your needs.

fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.name: ¡Aquí hay tomate! - Pomodoro
fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.summary: Pomodoro timer with a one-cell home screen widget. Dark, fast and quiet.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.description:
A Pomodoro timer that fits in one cell.
Every Pomodoro app ships a 2×2 widget at minimum, and it eats your home screen. "¡Aquí hay tomate!" ships a one-cell widget: tap to start or pause, double-tap to reset. No app to open, nothing to hunt for.
Work for 25 minutes, rest for 5, and take a long break every four Pomodoros. Or set it up however you like — every duration is yours.
Actually reliable. It fires on the right second with the screen off, after you swipe the app away, and after a reboot. A timer that runs late is no timer at all.
And good-looking. A black background and a red tomato that drains as time passes. No giant buttons, no toy interface.
Main features:
• 1×1 home screen widget: start, pause and reset without opening the app
• Full cycles of focus, short break and long break
• Every duration configurable, plus how many Pomodoros per cycle
• Statistics: completed Pomodoros, time focused, day streak, monthly map and trend
• End-of-slot alert with its own sound and repeat count, one for each end of the slot
• Configurable vibration length
• Optional auto-start of the next slot
• Notification with the countdown and pause, skip and reset buttons
• Respects silent mode and Do Not Disturb
• Spanish and English
No accounts. No cloud. No ads. No tracking. All your data stays on your phone.
The name is a Spanish pun: pomodoro is Italian for tomato, which is where the technique's name comes from. And yes, it also nods to an old tinned-tomato commercial.

fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.name: PassVault
fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.summary: A secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager.
fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.description:
PassVault is a secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager for Android.
PassVault is a lightweight password manager that allows users to securely store credentials on their device. All data is stored locally and sensitive information is encrypted using the Android Keystore system. The application does not require internet permissions. User data never leaves the device.
FEATURES:
- Secure Authentication: Access your vault using a PIN or Biometric (fingerprint) login.
- Encrypted Storage: All passwords are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and stored securely in a local Room database.
- 100% Offline-First: The app is fully functional without an internet connection.
- Password Generation: Create strong, random passwords directly within the app.
- Password Strength Scoring: Visual feedback on password security.
- Backups: Import or Export encrypted/unencrypted data
- Automatic Backups: Automatically backup your database with configurable retention and copies per backup.
- Custom Backup Location: Choose where to save your backups using Storage Access Framework.
- Third-Party Import: Seamlessly import existing vault from Bitwarden and KeePass.
- Supports JSON, CSV, and KDBX files.
- Custom Categories: Create and manage your own entry categories.
- Filter/Search Entries
- Block Screenshots: Prevent screen capture for enhanced security.

fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.name: QR Jukebox
fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.summary: Offline audio player for QR-linked music. Ideal for music trivia board games.
fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.description:
QR Jukebox is a lightweight, generic offline audio player designed to bridge the gap between physical objects and digital music. By mapping QR codes to your local music library, it becomes the perfect companion for DIY board games.
 Perfect for Music Trivia Games: This app was designed with versatility in mind. It is highly compatible with popular modern music trivia games (such as Hitster™). If you own a local collection of the songs from your favorite game, you can use QR Jukebox as a fast, privacy-friendly, and 100% offline alternative to the official online player. It even supports original URL structures to make mapping your library a breeze.
 How it works: The app scans a QR code containing a URL and maps it to a specific local audio file by mirroring the URL's path structure in your local filesystem.
 The domain of the URL is the root folder.
 All path segments before the last one are treated as subdirectories.
 The last segment is the track ID (filename prefix).
 Key Features: 
 Offline First: No internet connection required once your media is on the device.
 Privacy Focused: No tracking, no ads, and no cloud sync.
 Metadata and Art: Can display title, artist, album, and fullscreen cover art from ID3 tags.
 Customizable Playback: Set a global start offset (e.g. 30s) to skip intros automatically.
 Game Timer: Optional stopwatch to track "thinking time" per card or scan.
 Easy Navigation: Quick 10s skip buttons and smooth marquee for long titles.
 Supported Formats: .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .flac
 Disclaimer: This app is a generic tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Hitster™ or any other board game manufacturer. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.name: Termux Hub
fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.summary: A lightweight Android app that indexes Termux tools from metadata.
fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.description:
Termux Hub is a lightweight, open-source Android application that indexes and organizes tools designed for use with Termux .
 It provides a clean, searchable catalog of community tools using a transparent, metadata-driven data pipeline.
 The app focuses on reproducibility and reliability. All tool information is processed automatically from a public GitHub repository,
 validated, and stored locally on your device. Once synced, the local database becomes the single source of truth,
 ensuring fast access even when offline.
 Key features
 Browse and search curated Termux tools by category
 View detailed tool information, installation commands, and repositories
 Daily updates of GitHub star counts and README content (00:00 UTC)
 Offline-first design with local Room database storage
 No trackers, no analytics, no ads
 How it works
 Termux Hub fetches static metadata from GitHub and processes tool data, star counts,
 and README files independently. All validated data is stored in a local Room database.
 If syncing fails, the app safely falls back to cached or bundled data.
 Data sources
 All data is read-only and sourced from the public
 TermuxHub GitHub repository .
 This includes tool metadata, repositories, thumbnails, GitHub stars, READMEs,
 and Hall of Fame entries.
 Privacy
 Termux Hub does not collect personal data, does not require accounts,
 and does not include tracking, analytics, or advertising libraries.
 Contributing
 Anyone can help improve the catalog. To add or update a tool,
 please see the contribution guidelines in
 CONTRIBUTING.md .

fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.name: Tetherbug
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.summary: Your Mac turns on your phone's hotspot when its Wi-Fi disconnects. No taps.
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.description:
When your Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects, Tetherbug turns on your Android phone's hotspot and your Mac joins it, the way Instant Hotspot works with an iPhone. No reaching for your phone, no tapping through settings.
How it works
• Your Mac and phone stay paired over Bluetooth. When the Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects and no known network is around, it asks the phone for its hotspot.
• Tetherbug turns the hotspot on through Shizuku, and your Mac joins it.
• The hotspot shows up in your Mac's Wi-Fi menu as a Personal Hotspot, with the link icon, just like an iPhone's.
• Once nothing has used the hotspot for a while, Android turns it off again. You choose how long.
What you need
• Android 13 or later
• Shizuku, which lets Tetherbug switch the hotspot without root
• A Mac with macOS 14 or later, running the free Tetherbug app for Mac: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug
Private by design
• Tetherbug has no internet access and collects no data.
• Only a Mac you've paired with your phone can see its status or turn its hotspot on, and the Bluetooth link between them is encrypted.
Open source under the MIT license: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug

fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.name: Open TimeLimit
fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.description:
This App (Open TimeLimit) is mostly equal to TimeLimit without the linking of multiple devices.
Flexible
Apps are grouped to categories (a category can contain one or multiple App).
You can chose per category at which times it should be allowed. This allows preventing playing games too late.
Additionally, you can configure time limit rules. These rules limit the total usage duration at one day or over multiple days (e.g. a weekend). It is possible to combine both, e.g. 2 hours per week end day, but in total only 3 hours.
Moreover, there is the possibility to set an extra time. This allows using something longer than regulary once. This can be used as bonus. There is additionally the option to disable all time limits temporarily (e.g. for the whole day or an hour).
Multi user support
There is the scenario that one device is used by exactly one user. However, with tablets, there are often multiple possible users. Due to that, it is possible to create multiple user profiles in TimeLimit. Each user has got different settings and time counters. There are two kinds of users: parents and children. If a parent was chosen as user, then there are no restrictions. Parents can chose any other user as current user.
Notes
It can be a good idea to take a look at https://timelimit.io/en/configsuggestions/ if you don't use TimeLimit in the default scenario.
TimeLimit does not work good at some smartphone brands (mostly Huawei and Wiko). With the correct settings, it can work better. But better is not good.
If it "does not work": This can be caused by power saving features. You can find at https://dontkillmyapp.com/ how you can disable these features. Get in touch with the support if that does not help.
Depending on the Android version, TimeLimit uses the permission for the usage stats access or the GET_TASKS permission. These are only used to detect the currently used App. Based on the currently used App, the App is blocked, allowed, or the remaining time is calculated.
The device admin permission is used to detect an uninstallation of TimeLimit.
TimeLimit uses the notification access to block notifications of blocked apps and to count and block background playback. Notifications and their contents are not saved.
TimeLimit uses an accessibility service to press the home button before showing the lock screen. This fixes blocking in some cases. Moreover, this allows opening the lockscreen at newer Android versions.
TimeLimit uses the permission "draw over other Apps" to allow opening the lockscreen at newer android versions and to overlay blocked Apps until the lockscreen is launched.
TimeLimit uses the location access to detect the used WiFi network and allow/ block Apps depending on it and your settings. The location access is not used otherwise.

fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.name: Megrim: Migraine Log
fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.summary: Private, offline migraine log with automatic on-device pattern insights.
fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.description:
Smart migraine tracking that stays on your device.
Megrim is an open-source, offline-first migraine diary that helps you find your personal triggers. The app automatically adds time-of-day, season, daylight, and moon context to your entries — and, if you opt in, local weather and barometric pressure — calculating correlations entirely on your phone. With no accounts, no cloud servers, and zero tracking, your health data stays completely private and under your control.
What's inside:
* Automatic on-device enrichment — daylight hours, time of day, season, and moon phase computed locally; opt in to add local weather and barometric-pressure change (24h/48h). No manual entry.
* Real personal analytics — migraine days per month (the last 30 days, a 3-month average and a monthly chart), trends by day-of-week, time-of-day, season, daylight, pressure change, and moon phase, plus a "suspected factors" card that uses odds ratios over your own log.
* Clear days count too — tap "No migraine today" to record a good day, and Megrim compares your sleep, stress, triggers and foods on migraine days against clear days.
* Fast logging — one tap starts a migraine, or long-press the app icon and choose "Log migraine". Record symptoms, how much it affected your day, attacks without headache, medications and non-drug relief.
* Medications — classes for acute medications with a monthly medication-days count and a medication-overuse notice, preventives with start and stop dates, and what helped.
* Optional reminders — a daily reminder to log, and a "Migraine in progress" notification with an End button. Off until you turn them on (the notification permission is asked for only then), and never shown on a secure lock screen.
* Your data stays yours — on-device storage only, with full export and import (JSON and CSV), a printable PDF report for your doctor, and an optional backup reminder.
* Optional app lock — open Megrim with your phone's own fingerprint, face or PIN, and hide it in the recent-apps switcher.
* No accounts, no servers, no telemetry — by default the app makes no automatic network requests (the only exception is the place-name search you type when setting your home location). Weather enrichment is opt-in; when enabled, the only network request is to Open-Meteo.com, to fetch weather for the approximate (~1 km rounded) location and date of the entries you create.
* Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).
Megrim is a personal diary and is NOT a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. "Suspected factors" are statistical associations in your own log — association is not causation. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.
Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.

apple-macos:6783574263.name: BookSmarts
apple-macos:6783574263.description:
BookSmarts is a private EPUB reader and reading tracker built around your own library. Import your books, pick up exactly where you left off, turn every reading session into a clear picture of your reading life, and invite friends into a private Book Club when a story is better shared—without ads or a BookSmarts subscription. No BookSmarts account is required.
YOUR EPUB LIBRARY
• Import DRM-free EPUB books from Files
• Choose a folder for convenient automatic imports
• Continue reading from your saved place
• Organize books and series in Cover Grid
• Build a separate personal bookshelf with decorations, upright books, stacks, and adjustable title direction
• Create local cover-based or classic leather spines, upload your own artwork, or optionally generate full-art spines using your own OpenAI API account (separate provider charges apply)
• Sync saved shelf arrangements and spine artwork through iCloud
A READER THAT GETS OUT OF THE WAY
• Read in a focused, distraction-free view
• Choose page curl, slide, fade, rigid, or scrolling navigation
• Adjust text size and switch between day and night themes
• Save highlights and bookmarks
• Read across the outer and inner displays on iPhone Duo, with an optional two-page Book posture
• On supported iPhone Duo, optionally show cover art on the outer display with Performative Mode (requires an active camera session; no photos or video are recorded)
BUILD A READING HABIT
• Set a daily reading goal in minutes
• Log reading time and pages as you read
• Build streaks and review every reading day on your calendar
• Turn on optional reminders for unfinished daily goals
STATS THAT MEAN SOMETHING
• See reading time, pages, sessions, and completed books
• Follow your reading pace and speed over time
• Explore weekly charts and yearly reading goals
• Keep progress visible with Home Screen and native Mac widgets, including your bookshelf
• Explore finished books as a timeline or yearly bookshelf, and share a themed Year in Review
130 AWARDS TO UNLOCK
• Celebrate milestones for consistency, pages, pace, sessions, and finished books
• See the achievements closest to completion in your Trophy Case
READ TOGETHER IN PRIVATE BOOK CLUBS
• Create invitation-only groups around a book
• Compare chapter, progress, reading time, and standardized pages
• Discuss the story with automatic spoiler protection
• Link your own EPUB—book files are never redistributed
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Your library and reading history stay on your devices and in storage locations you choose
• No BookSmarts account is required
• Create backups of reading data, shelf layouts and saved artwork in a folder you control
• Keep saved spine image copies in your watched folder’s Spine Art folder
• Export reading sessions as CSV
• Optional club details and shared progress sync privately through iCloud
BookSmarts is made for readers who want a quiet, lightweight place to read their own EPUBs, understand their habits, and feel good about the time they spend with a book.

flathub:im.dino.Dino.name: Dino
flathub:im.dino.Dino.description:
Dino is a modern open-source chat client for the desktop. It focuses on providing a clean and reliable Jabber/XMPP experience while having your privacy in mind.
 It supports end-to-end encryption with OMEMO and OpenPGP and allows configuring privacy-related features such as read receipts and typing notifications.
 Dino fetches history from the server and synchronizes messages with other devices.

flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.name: Modular Calculator
flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.summary: A powerful, scriptable, modular calculator aimed at scientific, engineering or computing work.
flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.description:
A powerful, scriptable, modular calculator aimed at scientific, engineering or computing work. Long calculations can be written as a list of calculations, storing results into variables to be used in the next stage. All features can be added, removed, and customised, and new features can be written in python.
 Features:
 Numbers can be in any base and convert to another base
 Variable assignment
 Statistical and trigonometry functions
 Date and time manipulations and calculations
 Boolean logic
 Units, including conversion to other units - metric, US customary and British Imperial units supported
 Arrays - any operator or function can accept arrays as input and automatically execute across the entire array
 String manipulation, including regular expressions - strings can be used as numbers, and vice-versa
 User-defined functions - write your own functions you can then reuse
 Enable and disable any features in the calculator you wish, and customise how features work
 Write your own features in python to add to the calculator

flathub:io.howl.Editor.name: Howl
flathub:io.howl.Editor.summary: Lightweight editor with keyboard-centric minimalistic interface
flathub:io.howl.Editor.description:
Howl is a general purpose editor that aims to be both lightweight
 and fully customizable. It is built on top of the very fast LuaJIT
 runtime, and can be extended in either Lua or Moonscript. It has a
 minimalistic UI driven mainly by the keyboard.

flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.name: KCachegrind
flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.description:
KCachegrind is a profile data visualization tool, used to determine the most time consuming
 parts in the execution of a program.
 Features:
 KCachegrind visualizes profiles (i.e. runtime characteristics) of applications in various
 ways, including call graph visualisations and source/disassembler annotation.
 It can load profiles generated by the cache simulation/call tracer Calltree, a Valgrind tool.
 Thus, profiling does not need any preparation, can cope with shared libraries and plugin architectures,
 and does not influence the measuring itself.
 Converter scripts for OProfile, Perl, and PHP.
 Switching between multiple visualization layouts.
 Call graph can be exported as image (PNG).
 Simultaneous display of 2 event types in Call and Annotation View

flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.name: KMyMoney
flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.summary: Personal finance manager based on double-entry bookkeeping
flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.description:
KMyMoney is a personal finance manager by KDE. It comes with a large set of features while being
 easy to use for the non-technical user.
 It supports different account types, categorisation of expenses and incomes, reconciliation
 of bank accounts and import/export to the “QIF” file format. Direct download using the OFX and
 HBCI formats is also possible via plugins. Online banking support (statement download) is also
 provided for the OFX and HBCI protocols.

flathub:org.kde.skrooge.name: Skrooge
flathub:org.kde.skrooge.description:
Skrooge is a personal finance manager powered by KDE that aims to be simple and intuitive. Skrooge allows you to keep track of your expenses and income, categorize them, and build reports of them.
 Features:
 QIF, CSV, SKROOGE, KMYMONEY import/export
 Microsoft Money, OFX, QFX, MT940, GNUCASH, GRISBI, HOMEBANK and MONEY MANAGER EX import
 Advanced Graphical Reports
 Multiple tabs to help you organize your work
 Infinite undo/redo (even after the file was closed !)
 Instant filtering on transactions and reports
 Infinite category levels
 Mass update of transactions
 Scheduled transactions
 Track refund of your expenses
 Automatically process transactions based on search conditions
 Multiple currencies
 Budget
 Dashboard
 Advice

flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.name: mpz Music Player
flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.description:
A folder player for big local music collections. Instead of indexing every file into a library,
 mpz treats your files and folders as the library and provides a convenient way to build playlists
 directly from folders.
 The main feature is the three-column UI: a directory tree, the list of playlists, and the tracks
 of the current playlist — similar to Foobar2000's Album List. Choose library folders, middle-click
 a folder, and a playlist is created from it.
 Also supported: gapless playback, a 10-band and parametric equalizer with AutoEq presets, ReplayGain
 volume normalization, internet radio, CUE sheets, a tag editor, cover art and lyrics, MPRIS media
 control, and an experimental MPD client mode.

Download it separately from https://www.math.colostate.edu/~hulpke/transgrp/trans32.tgz if you need it. Groups of degree 48 are not included in Fedora due to the large size of the file (about 30 GB). fedora-packages:ghc-concurrent-extra/ghc.name: ghc-concurrent-extra
fedora-packages:ghc-concurrent-extra/ghc.description: The 'concurrent-extra' package offers among other things the following selection of synchronisation primitives: * 'Broadcast': Wake multiple threads by broadcasting a value. * 'Event': Wake multiple threads by signaling an event. * 'Lock': Enforce exclusive access to a resource. Also known as a binary semaphore or mutex. The package additionally provides an alternative that works in the 'STM' monad. * 'RLock': A lock which can be acquired multiple times by the same thread. Also known as a reentrant mutex. * 'ReadWriteLock': Multiple-reader, single-writer locks. Used to protect shared resources which may be concurrently read, but only sequentially written. * 'ReadWriteVar': Concurrent read, sequential write variables. Please consult the API documentation of the individual modules for more detailed information. This package was inspired by the concurrency libraries of Java and Python.

WHY LINKSENTRY?
Every day, millions of people fall victim to online scams. Scammers are getting more sophisticated — fake websites look identical to real ones, IP loggers hide in harmless-looking links, and fake downloads disguise themselves as popular software.
LinkSentry detects these threats and blocks them at the network level — before your data is ever sent.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FREE FEATURES

Automatically blocks 157,000+ known scam sites from 4 daily-updated feeds. Sites are blocked at network level — they never even load.
📍 IP Logger Detection (UNIQUE!)
Detects 70+ known IP tracking services like Grabify, IPLogger, and more. When someone sends you a tracking link, LinkSentry blocks it before your IP address, location, or device data is ever transmitted.
⌨️ Typosquatting Warnings
Detects when you land on a fake domain that looks similar to a known website (e.g., paypa1.com instead of paypal.com ).
💾 Download Protection
Pauses suspicious downloads (.exe, .msi, .dmg) from unknown or very new domains and warns you before you open them.
🔒 Browser Locker Protection
Prevents websites from freezing your browser with fake virus warnings designed to trick you into calling a scam hotline.
⚙️ Protocol Blocker
Blocks 45 dangerous protocols (ms-settings, steam, discord, etc.) that try to launch programs on your computer.
🔗 Tab Protection
Automatically prevents websites from manipulating your other open tabs (reverse tabnabbing).
🔔 Notification Blocker
Blocks fake captcha tricks that cause browser notification spam on your desktop.
📋 Clipboard Protection
Blocks automatic clipboard access that wasn't initiated by you.
🏪 Fake Shop Detection
Analyzes online shops for suspicious signals: new domain, missing legal pages, crypto-only payments, extreme discounts.
🔒 Form Protection
Warns you when you enter passwords or credit card data on suspicious sites.
🌐 WebRTC Protection

📊 Dashboard

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

firefox-addons:2792249.name: File System Access
firefox-addons:2792249.summary: The File System Access API allows web apps to interact with files on the local device.
firefox-addons:2792249.description:
This extension brings the File System Access API to Firefox that helps web apps such as https://vscode.dev read and write local files and folders.
Main features:
* Implemented showOpenFilePicker, showDirectoryPicker, showSaveFilePicker functions and related interfaces.
* Set to enable specific File System Access features on matching web pages.
* Provides File System Access API for other compatible WebExtensions.
Notes:
* The local file operations required by this extension cannot be performed in the browser, and a helper app needs to be installed to assist in the related work. 
* The optional Code Editor feature is provided by the Code Editor extension.
Limitations:
* By default, FileSystemHandle will lose its instance methods after cloning (e.g. using IndexedDB or postMessage ), and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.CLONE_ENABLED . Web developers can use __FILE_SYSTEM_TOOLS__.parseHandle(handle) to restore the instance methods.
* Limited Worker context support and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.WORKER_ENABLED .
* Read file size is limited by the FS_CONFIG.FILE_SIZE_LIMIT . Web developers can read large file streams and slices with handle.getFile({ _allowNonNative: true }) , and write large file in-place with handle.createWritable({ _inPlace: true, keepExistingData: true }) .
* DataTransferItem.prototype.getAsFileSystemHandle is not implemented.
This extension is open source and you can file bug reports or feature requests on the GitHub issue . 
References:
* https://wicg.github.io/file-system-access/

bluejetty:00024679:ios.name: SampleTank CS
bluejetty:00024679:ios.summary: SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professiona
bluejetty:00024679:ios.description:
SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professional live performance, song composition and puts a comprehensive array of world-class instruments, sounds and patterns right at your fingertips.
SampleTank CS provides all the functionality of the full app, with 23 instruments in 16 categories, so you can try out this powerful workstation for free. Additional sounds are available a la cart via in-app purchase.
SampleTank gives you 8 multitimbral instrument slots that you can easily layer or split. Choose from a comprehensive, expandable sound collection that covers virtually every acoustic and electronic sound imaginable. Plus, each instrument category includes instrument riffs and grooves so you can start composing and playing in no time.
The included instruments and the new sound engine are derived from the desktop version of SampleTank, IK's flagship workstation, offering you unmatched realism, variety of sound and audio performance. For the first time on iOS, thousands of professional sample-based sounds and patterns can be easily accessed, layered and used for playing live or in the studio. 
What’s more, SampleTank offers an ever-growing library of sounds and are available via in-app purchase:
• Elektronika - a series of electronica and EDM-oriented groove libraries and sound collections that make it easy to create hits in today’s most popular styles
• Miroslav Philharmonik — the legendary orchestral libraries, now available on your mobile device! Stunningly realistic and expressive samples of a wide range of orchestra and percussion instruments.
• SampleTank PRO - the latest and most high-end sounds and grooves available, letting you create professional-grade compositions on your mobile device
• Plus additional libraries covering cinematic sounds, the finest pianos, drum libraries from iconic drummers and much more!
SampleTank for iOS offers over 2,300 instruments and over 1,200 MIDI patterns — the largest collection of sounds available for any virtual instrument for iOS.
Features:
• 23 sounds in 16 categories included free
• 8-part multitimbral professional quality sound and groove module
• Expandable sound library with 2300+ instrument
• Over 1,200 melodic and rhythmic patterns
• 8-track MIDI recorder with audio export
• Totally redesigned intuitive interface
• New sound engine derived from SampleTank 3 for Mac/PC
• Zones feature lets you easily create splits & layers on your controller
• Song and Live environments for composing and playing
• Built-in insert effects and master reverb
• MIDI learn feature makes programming external controllers easy
• Plug-and-play compatibility with iRig interfaces and controllers
• Polyphony: up to 64 voices on new Apple devices

bluejetty:00015284:ios.name: Guitar Scales & Chords Power
bluejetty:00015284:ios.summary:
To improve your guitar playing, learn scales, chords, and the relationship between them. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your rhythm by practicing with the metronome.
Practice scale loops to master positions and develop muscle memo
bluejetty:00015284:ios.description:
To improve your guitar playing, learn scales, chords, and the relationship between them. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your rhythm by practicing with the metronome.
Practice scale loops to master positions and develop muscle memory. Engage in scale exercises that will improve your finger dexterity and ability to improvise. Begin slowly and gradually increase your speed as you improve.
Play scales and chords by swiping across the strings. The direction of the swipe determines whether the playback is ascending or descending. Tap on a note to play it.
Scale positions correspond to the CAGED system, which consists of five patterns that cover the fretboard for each scale. The chord shape for each position is displayed to assist you in learning it in any key.
The tuner offers a chromatic mode or the option to select from various tunings.
The tuner and instruments use an adj. reference frequency, set to 410 Hz - 470 Hz (default A = 440 Hz).
The Circle of Fifths displays common chords for a key, aiding in composing music, learning key signatures, and transposing songs to different keys.
Metronome provides click and drum voices, beat subdivisions, and tap to set the BPM (10 - 400). Time signatures: 2/2, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 3/8, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8, and 12/8.
Create PDF diagrams (color and black-and-white) of scale positions or all notes on a full fretboard, as well as diagrams of all chord notes on a full fretboard. These 8.5” x 11” PDFs are easy to print, save, and share.
FEATURES:
• Chromatic tuner
• Scale position and exercise loops with adj. playback speed
• Chord and scale information, including their compatibility
• Chord/scale notes display letter, interval, and fingering
• Chord/scale playback - choose from 5 instruments and set them independently
• Count-in option before scale playback
• Play scales and chords together to hear them in combination
• 48 alternate tunings

listings.name: Guitar Scales & Chords Power
listings.description:
To improve your guitar playing, learn scales, chords, and the relationship between them. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your rhythm by practicing with the metronome.

Practice scale loops to master positions and develop muscle memory. Engage in scale exercises that will improve your finger dexterity and ability to improvise. Begin slowly and gradually increase your speed as you improve.

Play scales and chords by swiping across the strings. The direction of the swipe determines whether the playback is ascending or descending. Tap on a note to play it.

Scale positions correspond to the CAGED system, which consists of five patterns that cover the fretboard for each scale. The chord shape for each position is displayed to assist you in learning it in any key.

The tuner offers a chromatic mode or the option to select from various tunings.

The tuner and instruments use an adj. reference frequency, set to 410 Hz - 470 Hz (default A = 440 Hz).

The Circle of Fifths displays common chords for a key, aiding in composing music, learning key signatures, and transposing songs to different keys.

Metronome provides click and drum voices, beat subdivisions, and tap to set the BPM (10 - 400). Time signatures: 2/2, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 3/8, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8, and 12/8.

bluejetty:00035654:ios.description:
Welcome to the CHSN App – the official app of the Chicago Sports Network. With more than 300 live Blackhawks, Bulls, and White Sox games annually, first-class pre- and-post game coverage, and 24/7 multisport programming, we are taking your Chicago sports fandom to the next level. 
Chicago Sports Network is the official home of the Blackhawks, Bulls, and White Sox, and the CHSN App is built by Chicago sports fans - for Chicago sports fans. The CHSN App is the best place to watch live games, the best highlights, and stay informed with real-time stats and team updates, ensuring you’re always in the loop. 
The App also offers access to CHSN's full slate of Chicago-focused sports programming, including shows about pro football, college football and the network’s cornerstone show, "The Chicago Lead," which highlights all of Chicago sports.
Whether you’re on-the-go or watching from home, CHSN brings the love of the game right to your fingertips. Download now and never miss a moment of the action.
Log in for free and subscribe to an annual or monthly plan.
This app offers monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions. You may cancel your subscription in your phone settings at any time. 
Monthly & Annual subscriptions are available. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://chsn.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://chsn.com/privacy-policy
CHSN content can also be viewed in retail locations and various venues throughout the US.

bluejetty:00026802:ios.description:
The best way to view WYDOT 511 traffic alerts, road conditions and travel information.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + WYDOT 511 Traffic Incidents
 + Road Conditions & Planned Events
 + Customizable Push Notifications
 + Home Screen Camera Widgets
 + Winter Weather Analysis
 + CCTV Cameras
WYDOT TRAFFIC INCIDENTS INCLUDE:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather / wind advisories, heavy traffic, road closures, chain control, planned construction
CCTV CAMERAS
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
HOME SCREEN CAMERA WIDGETS
Add up to (4) home screen widgets displaying your favorite CCTV cams.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Track WYDOT incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by WYDOT. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
ROAD CONDITION CATEGORIES INCLUDE:
Dry, scattered showers, rain, wet slushy, high wind, poor visibility, snow, drifted snow, black ice, icy, icy spots, blowing snow, closed, rock slide
WINTER WEATHER ANALYSIS:
 - NOAA Snowfall Reports
 - Current Radar
 - NWS Watches & Warnings
 - Winter Weather Severity Index
TERMS & CONDITIONS
https://lwbrandsllc.com/wyoming-road-conditions-app-terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00031027:ios.description:
Your Skin. Finally Understood.
Skin Bliss is the world’s smartest skincare app—powered by science, built for real results.
From AI face scanning to routine planning, ingredient safety checks to daily tracking, Skin Bliss is your complete skincare operating system.
Whether you’re just starting out or you’ve tried everything—Skin Bliss helps you finally understand what your skin truly needs, build the right routine, and track visible progress over time.
Powered by AI. Backed by science. Loved by skincare geeks.
We combine cutting-edge AI, ingredient research, and dermatological expertise to help you:
• Discover your true skin profile
• Build a routine that fits your goals, lifestyle, and concerns
• Avoid product clashes, overuse, or missing steps
• Track your visible progress with photos, mood logs, and our AI analyzer
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH SKIN BLISS
Face Scanner – Your Skin Profile in Seconds
Scan your face to detect visible concerns and build a personalized profile: skin type, concerns, and what your routine should actually do.
Routine Builder & Templates
Build from scratch or start with expert-designed routines. Schedule products with ingredient-smart logic, daily or on rotation.
Routine Evaluator + Timeline
Evaluate your full routine: what goals it supports, what’s missing, and how long to expect results.
Routine Player
Follow your routine step by step with timing, application guidance, and mirror mode—so every product works better.
Skin Diary
Track how your skin feels, log symptoms, note triggers, and reflect on daily patterns.
AI Photo Comparison
Upload daily photos and let our AI analyze progress vs. your original scan—spot subtle shifts over time.
Side-by-Side Product Comparison
Compare any products by ingredients, performance, price, and suitability for your skin.
Ingredient Compatibility Checker
Check for clashes, duplication, or irritation risks between products in your routine.
Shelf Analysis
Take a photo of your skincare shelf and instantly analyze all your products—together and individually.
Weather-Driven Skincare Tips
Get personalized product tips based on your local climate, UV, and humidity.
Smart Product Search & Analyzer
Scan barcodes, paste ingredient lists, or search 100 k+ products to see if they match your skin and routine goals.
Product Organizer
Build your routine shelf, wishlist, and expiration tracker.
Skincare Programs (incl. Clear Your Acne)
Follow expert-led video courses for acne, skincare foundations, and beyond.
84% of Users See Results
In a survey of tens of thousands of users, 84% said their skin visibly improved since starting with Skin Bliss.
Built by scientists. Loved by skincare geeks.
Skin Bliss is a skincare intelligence platform for beginners, product junkies, and anyone with stubborn concerns.
Available in 14 languages
English, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Portuguese, Polish, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian and Turkish
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Download Skin Bliss and enjoy a FREE trial of Skin Bliss Pro for a limited time!
Unlock unlimited scans, advanced insights, routine timelines, photo comparisons, and more.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel any time in your Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://skinbliss.app/privacy
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Questions? Contact us at: info@getskinbliss.com

bluejetty:00041031:ios.description:
Snipe to win eBay auctions using Auction Sniper for iOS! 
Welcome to hands-free auction bidding and winning. Back and better than ever, Auction Sniper will place an automated bid, based on your preferences, in the last seconds of an eBay auction to increase your chances of a winning bid. With the improved Auction Sniper app you can:
• Save time by no longer having to watch the end of an auction.
• Import eBay watches and easily place, edit and delete snipes.
• App Notifications to let you know when you have been outbid, lose or win an Auction.
• Sort searches by price, end time or newly listed.
• Directly fund your Auction Sniper account with PayPal.
• And more!
Plus, you can try Auction Sniper for free! After you sign up, open the Auction Sniper activation email and click the "account activation" link to receive your 3 free snipes. After your first 3 winning snipes, you will be charged only 1.75% of the final auction price with fees as low as $0.35 USD for only the auctions you win.

bluejetty:00014552:ios.name: Parts Town
bluejetty:00014552:ios.summary: The first and #1 app in the foodservice equipment industry allows you to take Parts Town on the go! Find and buy the real OEM commercial kitchen parts you need and access online equipment manuals with our user-friendly, innovative parts ID
bluejetty:00014552:ios.description:
The first and #1 app in the foodservice equipment industry allows you to take Parts Town on the go! Find and buy the real OEM commercial kitchen parts you need and access online equipment manuals with our user-friendly, innovative parts ID tools. Wherever your day (or night) takes you, we’re here to help every step of the way from simple fixes to large projects in commercial kitchens.
Quick Search – Search by manufacturer, model and/or part category all in one place to swiftly narrow your search. You'll find everything for fryers, combi ovens, ice machines, refrigeration and much more.
My Equipment – Log into your account to save the commercial kitchen equipment you own or service to access parts and manuals.
My Parts – Save a list of foodservice parts you use most for easy reordering. 
Saved Manuals – Find the OEM manual you need, download it to your device and save it for easy reference.
Smart Manuals – Tens of thousands of hyperlinked commercial food equipment manuals that lead directly to product detail pages. You can even save them on your device to view offline.
Interactive Diagrams – Bringing technical schematics to life, these diagrams show a detailed breakdown of parts. Refer to product details and add a part to your cart without leaving the diagram.
Serial Number Lookup – Enter your equipment’s serial number to see an exact list of restaurant equipment parts needed, along with available warranty info.
Synchronized Cart – Your shopping cart is available across all of your devices when you log into your account. It’s easy to pick up right where you left off anytime.
Order History and Tracking – Just log into your account to see your previous orders and find out where your stuff is. 
Live Chat – When you need a little help, chat with a friendly expert in real time.
Join the hundreds of thousands already here when you download today! We’ll see you around Town.

bluejetty:00015861:ios.description:

"Bible" of the medical ward - helps you diagnose and treat hundreds of medical conditions. Consult clinical recommendations from a resource that has been trusted on the wards for 75+ years. Selected as a Doody’s Core Title for 2023!
The Washington Manual® of Medical Therapeutics provides essential information you need for successful patient care, with concise, high-yield content that reflects today’s fast-changing advances in medical technology and therapeutics. Written by faculty, residents, and fellows and edited by chief residents of the distinguished Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis, the Washington Manual presents brief, logical approaches to diagnosis and management of commonly encountered medical conditions, including new therapies that improve patient outcomes. Discover why housestaff and faculty around the world depend on this best-selling resource for day-to-day clinical practice in internal medicine. 
KEY FEATURES
- Provides comprehensive coverage of many areas of medicine and the core subspecialties all at your fingertips for quick review and reference 
- Features a new, colorful presentation with easy-to-follow guidelines, tables, diagrams, and dosing and treatment information 
- Includes easy-to-use algorithms for fast visual guidance 
- Addresses challenges that residents, interns, medical students, and other practitioners confront every day 
- Features content carefully edited by Internal Medicine Chief Residents from the Washington University School of Medicine and Barnes-Jewish Hospital in St. Louis

bluejetty:00036882:ios.name: CV Maker – Job Resume Creator
bluejetty:00036882:ios.summary: CV Maker is an iOS app for creating a professional resume or CV and exporting it as a PDF for a job application. Use this app to build a job resume on iPhone or iPad when you need a polished document to send. It is for students, graduates,
bluejetty:00036882:ios.description:
CV Maker is an iOS app for creating a professional resume or CV and exporting it as a PDF for a job application. Use this app to build a job resume on iPhone or iPad when you need a polished document to send. It is for students, graduates, career changers, professionals, and executives who want a finished resume without design skills or a computer.
Job seekers need a clear resume they can email, upload, or print. Layout work and desktop software slow that down. CV Maker walks you through each section and formats the document, so you leave with a PDF ready to apply.
What CV Maker does
• Build a resume step by step: summary, work history, education, skills, languages, certifications, references, links, and custom sections.
• Choose from 100+ resume and CV templates, including ATS-friendly and Europass layouts, and recolor a template you like.
• Export the finished resume as a PDF you can email, upload to an application, or print.
• Write a cover letter that matches the resume and export that letter as a PDF.
• Keep several resume versions and tailor each one to a different job.
• Add a photo and a signature to the resume.
• Edit in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Russian.
CV Maker is a resume and CV builder for job applications. You write the text. The app formats the document. It does not search for jobs or score your resume.
Who it is for
• Students and graduates building a first resume from education, internships, and skills.
• Career changers who need a work history that shows transferable skills.
• Experienced professionals presenting achievements and progression.
• Executives choosing a senior layout for leadership roles.
How to use
Enter your information, pick a template, preview the resume, and export a PDF. Update it anytime and keep more than one version for different applications.
Privacy
Your resume content stays on your device. CV Maker does not upload it to a server.
Pricing
CV Maker uses in-app purchases. A limited try covers one saved resume, one custom section, and one PDF download after a 24-hour wait. Premium unlocks instant PDF export, cover letters, and multiple resume versions.
Download CV Maker and create your professional resume on iPhone or iPad.
Terms of Use: https://cvbuilderapp.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://cvbuilderapp.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00014411:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling new and used heavy equipment on a global scale. Whether you're looking for farm machinery, construction equipment, commercial trucks, utility trailers, parts, attachments, and so much more, MarketBook makes connecting with buyers and sellers across the world fast, easy, and secure. 
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
With just one app, you can tap into equipment markets in Canada, Central and Latin America, South Africa, as well as New Zealand, and Indonesia, just to name a few. Select your location and language in the app and access thousands of quality listings with just one tap. Browse a wide inventory of listings for various types of heavy equipment, including tractors, excavators, loaders, and trailers. Find the perfect machinery to meet your operational needs.
Once you've narrowed your search by location and category, view detailed specifications, photos, and videos of your desired equipment. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal before someone else beats you to it.
The MarketBook app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, manufacturer, year, price range, condition, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters to find exactly what you need.
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite listings or post a "Want-to-Buy" ad to let sellers know what you're searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email while browsing category pages that are updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you're a dealer or an independent seller, MarketBook connects you with thousands of qualified buyers across the world actively searching for heavy machinery and vehicles.
Consign your inventory with MarketBook to reach a global audience. Click the “My Inventory” button in your MarketBook app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app—your trusted and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE MARKETBOOK APP FOR ALL YOUR EQUIPMENT NEEDS 
Whether you're upgrading your fleet or selling machinery, MarketBook connects you with a vast inventory of heavy equipment along with a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, MarketBook links you to a network of trusted equipment marketplaces, including Machinery Trader, TractorHouse, Truck Paper, and others serving the agricultural, trucking, construction, and other heavy-duty industries across the world.
GET THE MARKETBOOK APP NOW 
Thousands of dealers and single equipment owners trust MarketBook to manage their operations. Download the app today to find your next piece of equipment or sell it with ease!

bluejetty:00028681:ios.description:
Welcome to Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon, an engaging restaurant business and management simulation game!
As the owner of a restaurant, you're about to embark on a journey to become a skilled manager and build a thriving culinary establishment. Join us now and immerse yourself in this exciting and delightful adventure in Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon!
1. Take customer orders.
Your staff will handle orders, cook, and serve food to your guests. Sit back and relax, as this game is perfect for idle gaming enthusiasts like you!
2. Prepare delectable dishes.
Your restaurant can whip up a wide variety of dishes, from soups, coffees, and lemonades to hot dogs, burgers, pizzas, and more! Don't forget to hire special characters to expedite your business operations.
3. Earn revenue from food sales.
Satisfy all your customers with your outstanding cuisine, and they'll happily pay for their meals, often leaving an extra tip!
4. Upgrade and decorate your restaurant.
Use the money earned from food sales to purchase equipment and furnishings, ranging from basic to modern. Personalize your dream restaurant according to your preferences.
5. Expand your restaurant.
Begin with a small establishment and gradually expand it into a spacious restaurant equipped with all the amenities to serve your customers better.
Demonstrate your exceptional management skills!
As long as you put in the effort, customers will flock to your restaurant. With your creativity and managerial acumen, there are no limits to what you can achieve in Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon.
This game is a perfect fit for the following individuals:
- Enthusiasts of cute games, food market tycoon game!
- Food lovers who crave dishes like pizza, burgers, hot dogs, gimbap, sushi, pasta, and more...
- Fans of relaxing games, idle games, and simulation games!
- Players who prefer offline and idle gaming experiences!
- Those who enjoy single-player and free games!
Play Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon and become the most successful restaurant boss! Showcase your talent in restaurant management, craft delightful dishes, and provide an exceptional dining experience for every customer. The culinary world eagerly awaits your expertise!

bluejetty:00040882:ios.name: ดวง Live - ดูดวง สด ผ่านแอพ
bluejetty:00040882:ios.summary:
อยาก ดูดวง แต่ไม่รู้จะดูกับใคร หรือไม่รู้หาหมอที่ไหน เราขอแนะนำ แอพพลิเคชั่น "ดวง Live" (ดวงไลฟ์) ดูดวงออนไลน์ ทำนายโชคชะตาชีวิต กับหมอดูแม่นๆ ผ่านหน้าจอมือถือ ไม่ยุ่งยาก สะดวกสบายดูได้ทุกที่ ที่มีเน็ต ดูดวงได้หลากหลายรูปแบบ
- ดูดวง แบบวิด
bluejetty:00040882:ios.description:
อยาก ดูดวง แต่ไม่รู้จะดูกับใคร หรือไม่รู้หาหมอที่ไหน เราขอแนะนำ แอพพลิเคชั่น "ดวง Live" (ดวงไลฟ์) ดูดวงออนไลน์ ทำนายโชคชะตาชีวิต กับหมอดูแม่นๆ ผ่านหน้าจอมือถือ ไม่ยุ่งยาก สะดวกสบายดูได้ทุกที่ ที่มีเน็ต ดูดวงได้หลากหลายรูปแบบ
- ดูดวง แบบวิดีโอคอล แบบส่วนตัว
- ดูดวง แบบโทรศัพท์ แบบส่วนตัว
- ดูดวง แบบแชทคำถาม (พิมพ์ข้อความแชท, ข้อความเสียง, รูปภาพ)
- ดูฤกษ์ยาม, ฤกษ์มงคล, เบอร์มงคล, เลขมงคล และฤกษ์ยามต่างๆ
แอพดูดวงที่รวบรวมหมอดู และนักโหราศาสตร์มากประสบการณ์กว่า 2000+ คน มีครบทุกศาสตร์การพยากรณ์ ทั้ง ดูดวงโหราศาสตร์ไทย ดูดวงไพ่ยิปซี ไพ่ทาโรต์ ไพ่ออราเคิล โหราศาสตร์จีน ดูเบอร์มงคล ดูฤกษ์ยามมงคล ดูดวงความรัก ดูดวงมือถือ ทะเบียนรถ ทะเบียนบ้าน ฯลฯ
แอปพลิเคชั่นดูดวงสุดเจ๋ง! คัดหมอดูทั่วฟ้าเมืองไทย ทั้งแม่น และหลากหลาย มาให้กับคุณ ใช้งานง่ายไม่ยุ่งยาก สนุก และน่ารักด้วยตัวการ์ตูนสุดแนว! บอกลาการดูดวงแบบเก่าๆโบราณๆไปได้เลย
นอกจากดูดวงสดๆกับหมอดูแล้ว เรายังมีบทความดูดวงรายวันแม่นๆให้อ่านทุกวัน หรือจะดูเบอร์โทรศัพท์ หรือดูดวงฟรีจากการจับยาม ก็มีให้ดูแบบฟรีๆ
หากคุณยังไม่แน่ใจ เรามีระบบ คุณภาพตามดาวของหมอดู และรีวิวจากลูกค้าจริงกว่าแสนราย ว่ามีความน่าเชื่อถือมากน้อยแค่ไหน เพื่อความสบายใจของตัวท่านเอง!!!
สามารถเลือกดูดวงตามงบประมาณของท่านได้ มีทั้งหมอดูที่รับ ดูดวงฟรี และหมอดูที่รับดูในราคาย่อมเยาว์ ไปจนถึงหมอดูระดับปรมาจารย์
การันตีความแม่น คุ้มค่า แน่นอน!
----------------------------------------
(สำหรับหมอดู ที่ต้องการร่วมงานกับดวง live)
ท่านสามารถโหลดแอพแล้วสมัคร โดยเลือกที่ปุ่ม “หมอดูเข้าสู่ระบบ”
เมื่อทำการตรวจสอบแล้วทางทีมงานจะอนุมัติบัญชีของท่าน ท่านจึงจะสามารถเข้าสู่ระบบ และรับลูกค้าได้ 
ทีมงานจะติดต่อกลับทางช่องทางติดต่อที่ท่านให้ไว้

bluejetty:00023285:ios.description:
Build a full suit from King to Ace. Clear the run. Do it eight times and the board is yours.
Spider Solitaire: Suit Master is the classic, dealt clean and playable anywhere. No connection, no timers you did not ask for, nothing between you and the next deal.
CHOOSE HOW HARD YOU WANT IT
- 1 suit: welcoming, forgiving, a good place to learn the rhythm
- 2 suits: the balanced version most players settle into
- 4 suits: the real test, where every column matters
- Spiderette: a faster single-deck variant when you have five minutes
HOW IT WORKS
Stack cards in descending order. When you assemble a full King-to-Ace run in one suit, it clears. Out of moves? Deal a new row across the tableau and keep going.
A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
One fresh deal daily, the same for everyone. Keep the streak or skip a day. Nothing here punishes you for stopping.
UNLIMITED UNDO AND SMART HINTS

bluejetty:00045517:ios.description:
Make the most of your fundraising with the Wounded Warrior Project® (WWP) Carry Forward 5K® mobile app!
With this app, Carry Forward 5K participants can:
- Track your fundraising progress
- Receive notifications when new donations come in
- Manage and update your fundraising page
- Share a QR code so others can donate to your page
- Text and email your contacts to ask for donations
- Share progress updates to Facebook and LinkedIn
- Squad leaders only: Manage your squad, track your squad's progress, and communicate with squad members
And much more!
Please note: The Carry Forward mobile app is intended for current registrants of the WWP Carry Forward 5K. If you haven't registered yet, please visit wwpcarryforward.org to register today.

bluejetty:00017007:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017007:ios.description:
Pyramid Solitaire Saga, from the makers of Candy Crush Saga & Farm Heroes Saga!
Deal with the magic!
Challenge awaits you in this magical Solitaire game.
Join Helena and her loyal companion Kingsley on their journey to reveal the wonders of the Ancient World.
Find the clues by catching the Scarabs hidden beneath the Cards. You can match a Card that is one greater or lower than the one on your deck. 
Catch the running Scarabs and uncover clues to help you on your journey and reveal the long-hidden treasures and magic of the Ancients. 
Complete each episode to reveal a hidden treasure and transport to magical new worlds on a quest to reignite Khepri's prophecy.
Explore the lost places of the world where epic adventures await you in The Hidden Tomb, The Emerald Dream and beyond! 
Take on this Saga alone or play with friends to see who can get the highest score! 
Pyramid Solitaire Saga is completely free to play but some in-game items such as extra moves or lives will require payment.
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Pyramid Solitaire Saga features:
• Experience a new way of playing Solitaire with rich and exotic graphics set in Ancient Times
• Transport to magical new worlds with Helena the Treasure Hunter and Kingsley the cunning gerbil
• Powerful boosters to help with challenging levels
• Journey through exciting levels to unlock boosters and hidden treasures!
• Easy and fun to play, challenging to master 
• Hundreds of adventurous levels to complete – more to come!
• Leaderboards to watch your friends and competitors!
• Easily sync the game between devices and unlock full game features when connected to the Internet
• Available to play on mobile and tablet devices 
Already a fan of Pyramid Solitaire Saga? Like us on Facebook or follow us on Twitter for the latest news: 
facebook.com/PyramidSolitaireSaga
twitter.com/PyramidSaga
Do not sell my data: King shares your personal information with advertising partners to personalize ads. Learn more at https://king.com/privacyPolicy. If you wish to exercise your Do Not Sell My Data rights, you can do so by contacting us via the in game help centre or by going to https://soporto.king.com/
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Pyramid Solitaire Saga!
IARC rating: 3+

bluejetty:00023843:ios.name: Moatheni: Muslim Prayer Times
bluejetty:00023843:ios.summary:
• Moatheni – Your Daily Companion for Prayer and Worship
Moatheni is designed to be with you every moment of the day, helping you pray on time, recite the Quran, and remember Allah, it combines precision with a modern, fast, and intuitive
bluejetty:00023843:ios.description:
• Moatheni – Your Daily Companion for Prayer and Worship
Moatheni is designed to be with you every moment of the day, helping you pray on time, recite the Quran, and remember Allah, it combines precision with a modern, fast, and intuitive design, all in a completely ad-free experience.
• Prayer Times & Qibla
Automatically detect accurate prayer times anywhere in the world, with a precise Qibla direction and an interactive map to help you find the correct direction with ease.
• Daily Athkar
Keep your daily remembrance close at hand with a complete collection of authentic athkar, including morning and evening athkar, before and after sleep, and much more. Enjoy beautiful audio recitations and supplications from the Quran and Sunnah.
• The Quran, Always With You
Read the entire Quran, listen to your favorite reciters in the background, start your Khatmah with a clear reading plan, and stay consistent with daily reminders for your assigned portion.
• Smart Prayer Notifications
Never miss a prayer with highly customizable notifications, before, on, and after athan, featuring beautiful sounds and flexible notification options. Receive additional notifications for the last third of the night, Duha prayer, fasting days, and Friday hour.
• Full Athan 
Listen to full athan for every prayer, even when your device is locked.
• Beautiful Widgets
A variety of widgets display prayer times, countdowns to the next prayer, supplications, the Hijri date, and more on your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island.
• Elegant Modern Design
Inspired by Apple’s design language, Moatheni offers a smooth, refined, and elegant experience with exceptional performance and attention to detail.
• Athkar Notifications
Receive notifications for Tasbeeh, Istighfar, Salah, and other athkar at any time you choose throughout the day.
• Islamic Events
Stay informed about important Islamic occasions with accurate dates and countdowns to upcoming events.
• Apple Watch Integration
View prayer times and athkar directly on your wrist with beautifully designed watch faces for every style.
• Daily Worship Tracker
Monitor your daily acts of worship and stay motivated with an elegant interface and dedicated widget.
• Day & Night Sunnah Guide
Know the time for Sunnah prayers, Duha, Qiyam Al-Layl, prohibited prayer times, Surah Al-Kahf, and more, all presented at the appropriate time.
• Nearby Mosques & Eqamah Times
Quickly find nearby mosques and set accurate eqamah times for every prayer.
• Dedicated Support
Access a comprehensive help center, frequently asked questions, and contact our support team directly via email or WhatsApp.
• Share anything
Share athkar, supplications, and prayer times with beautifully designed cards and wallpapers across your favorite social platforms.
• And Much More
Gregorian to Hijri date converter
Daily Quran verse with Tafsir
Fully customizable notifications
Authentic daily Hadith
Daily supplications on the Home screen
Daily Hijri calendar card with useful information
Midnight and last third times
Current moon phase
Zakat calculators 
Daily Islamic benefits
Friday hour calculations
Monthly prayer times calendar
Display Hijri calendar and date 
Complete privacy
Dark Mode support and app icon customization
Beautiful wallpapers that change according to prayer times
Continuous updates with new features and improvements
Moatheni: Because worship deserves a companion you can rely on.

bluejetty:00015750:ios.name: Steer Clear®
bluejetty:00015750:ios.developer: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
bluejetty:00015750:ios.summary: The Steer Clear® app is part of a comprehensive program that helps young drivers reinforce positive driving behavior. Young drivers, under age 25, who complete the Steer Clear® Safe Driver Program, may be eligible for an adjustment to the p
bluejetty:00015750:ios.description:
The Steer Clear® app is part of a comprehensive program that helps young drivers reinforce positive driving behavior. Young drivers, under age 25, who complete the Steer Clear® Safe Driver Program, may be eligible for an adjustment to the premium on their State Farm® auto insurance. The Steer Clear mobile application tracks a driver's progress through pre-set learning modules of updated content including topics such as Bluetooth, distracted driving (texting/games), and special driving situations. Drivers will no longer need to manually record their trips if the program is conducted through this app. Throughout their trips, drivers will be scored and given feedback on their braking, acceleration, and cornering. Once a driver completes the program, they will receive a program completion certificate that they can text, email, or bring into the agent's office. Badges have been added to Steer Clear to recognize and reward a variety of specific driving accomplishments. The badges will help align users to shared goals of the app, such as scoring a certain percentage on a specific driving behavior, while acting as virtual, motivational status symbols.
Feel free to leave comments on the App Store or on our Facebook Teen Driver Safety page: www.facebook.com/sfteendriving
*The Steer Clear® Safe Driver Program is not available in all states.

bluejetty:00036612:ios.summary: «Find Differences - Spot It» is a puzzle game of attentiveness and concentration, in which you have to find 10 differences in pictures. This game develops observation skills, visual thinking, improves memory, reduces stress and increases co
bluejetty:00036612:ios.description:
«Find Differences - Spot It» is a puzzle game of attentiveness and concentration, in which you have to find 10 differences in pictures. This game develops observation skills, visual thinking, improves memory, reduces stress and increases concentration. The game has no time limit and is suitable for all ages.
How to play?
1. Look closely at two similar pictures.
2. Find an obvious difference and click on it.
3. If you have difficulties, use the hint.
4. Do not overuse them - they are limited!
5. After passing one image, move on to the next.
Game features:
- No time limit
- Content suitable for all ages
- Different difficulty levels and a smooth entry threshold
- Various image themes
- Hints and zoom function
- Ability to play offline
- Dark theme and much more inside!
If you encounter a bug or have any suggestions, please send us an email at support@bytecore.studio. We appreciate your feedback and will definitely take it into account in future updates. Thank you for playing our game!
We now have our own community on Discord, join us and participate in the development of our application: https://discord.gg/yhmBTQ8YtC
Privacy Policy: https://bytecore.studio/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://bytecore.studio/terms

bluejetty:00017299:ios.summary:
- Unrestricted character creations!
With more than 500 billion combinations available, feel free to create your own character to your liking!
- Sword? Magic? Anything you like!
"Profession", which is often the case with RPG, does not exist
bluejetty:00017299:ios.description:
- Unrestricted character creations!
With more than 500 billion combinations available, feel free to create your own character to your liking!
- Sword? Magic? Anything you like!
"Profession", which is often the case with RPG, does not exist in Toram. Sword? (Magic) Staff? Bow? Halberd? Feel free to decide your own fighting style!
- Build & Train your character to your heart's content!
Equipped with a "Skill Tree" system enabling players to enhance and strengthen their characters as they wish.
Create combos and discover your own battle style!
- Changeable weapons and equipment color! 
You can color your favorite weapon with the color you like when you obtain equipment with a "Color Info"!
Moreover, you can freely create the abilities of your equipment as you proceed further with the game...!
- Go on an adventure with your friends across the country!
RPG (MMORPG) that can be played and connects you with your friends online across the country!
The powerful monster that you fail to beat on your own could possibly be knocked down by forming a party with your friends! Let's explore the vast and beautiful 3D world with many friends!
- Party play even by yourself!
You can even enjoy party play when you are playing alone by borrowing and battling together with other player's character known as "mercenary" or by summoning a "partner" from your own sub-characters!
【Story Setting】
Decades ago, the world was hit by a devastating catastrophe, crumbling the ground into pieces. The gods quickly gathered the pieces scattered in all directions and hurriedly put them together. The result, a bizarre looking world resembling a mosaic.
The nation that was originally there had ceased to exist. As a result of repeated clashes of principles and interests among the 4 tribes, the people split into 4 factions.
At such times, an adventurer (you) came to this peculiar world.
The adventurer (you) goes through a series of adventures while meeting various people belonging to the 4 factions in the world to confront the secretly proliferating mysteries behind it....
【Game Details】
Title: Toram Online - Departure from Iruna -
Category: MMORPG with complete freedom
[Recommended Requirements]
OS : iOS 16 or later & iPadOS 16 or later
SoC : Apple A14 / M1 or higher
RAM : 4GB or more
Internet Connection : Wi-Fi (Upload / Download 10 Mbps or more)
[Supported Devices]
iPhone 12 or later
iPhone SE 3rd generation or later
iPad Pro 5th generation or later
iPad Air 4th generation or later
iPad 11th generation or later
iPad mini 6th generation or later
[Unsupported Devices]
iPhone 11/11 Pro/11 Pro Max
iPhone SE 2nd generation
iPad Pro 4th generation
iPad Air 3rd generation
iPad 10th generation
iPad mini 5th generation
iPod Touch 7th generation
【Service performance and availability are not guaranteed when】
・Devices do not meet the recommended system requirements
・Devices are no longer supported by Apple Inc.
・Apps not supported by Apple Inc. are being used on your device
・Apps that root your device are being used
・Virtual machines or emulators are being used
・VPN(Virtual Private Network) is being used
・The beta version of the Operating System is being used
-----------------
- This game is an online game, so you are required to connect to WiFi if you are using iPad.
- Please use a stable internet connection to play.
- System requirements and supported devices are subject to change with future updates.
- The gaming performance depends on your device.
- You may not be able to connect to the game due to maintenances or slow Internet connection.
- Please enjoy the game with other players with respect and good manners. 
-----------------

bluejetty:00038955:ios.description:
Quabble: Daily Mental Health
Ease anxiety & lift mood
Reduce stress, anxiety, and depression with joyful daily self-care routines. Quabble offers a wide range of therapist-backed mental health practices to support your well-being. With your Quabble Duck by your side, caring for your mental health becomes a natural and uplifting part of every day.
All-in-One Mental Health App
Developed by people who understand real-life challenges, Quabble brings evidence-based practices and mindfulness training into one easy-to-use app. No more juggling multiple apps for meditation, journaling, sleep, or emotional support, Quabble helps you manage it all in one calming place.
Why users love Quabble
98% say it helps manage mental health
87% report improved well-being
10 million+ wellness routines completed
What You’ll Find Inside
Therapist-Backed Workouts
Practice CBT-inspired grounding, positive affirmations, gratitude reflection, and mindfulness meditation to strengthen six key areas of wellness: Emotional Regulation, Physical Health, Sleep, Mindfulness, Social Support, and Personal Growth.
Daily Mini-Routines & Habit Tracker
Start mornings with intention and end with reflection. The First Bloom Journey 15-day program helps you build sustainable self-care habits, track progress, and celebrate growth with small rewards.
Your Virtual Park
Design a calm sanctuary that mirrors your journey. Decorate with flowers and cozy decos, dress your Duck in cute outfits, and invite friendly animal companions.
Support for Anxiety & Depression
Use science-based tools like 54321 Grounding, 1-Minute Breathing, Pleasant Activities, Safe Place, Tai Chi, and the Calm-Down Kit to ease panic, stress, and racing thoughts between therapy sessions.
A Caring Community
Share thoughts in the Bamboo Forest and connect with others who truly understand—judgment-free. Write letters to your past or future self, or create a personal Safe Place for reflection.
Track Your Progress
Visual insights across six pillars of mental health help you understand patterns in mood, sleep, mindfulness, and overall wellness.
Beautiful & Relaxing Design
Praised for its soothing visuals, Quabble makes practicing mindfulness, relaxation, and emotional balance feel easy and aesthetic.
Some of Quabble’s Most Loved Workouts
Gratitude Jar
Boost resilience and positivity with daily gratitude reflections.
Mood Diary
Track emotions and notice patterns to strengthen emotional regulation.
Moonlight
Drift into better sleep with soothing sounds and mindful relaxation.
Safe Place
Create a calm mental sanctuary for stress relief and anxiety support.
54321 Grounding
A therapist-recommended tool to ease panic and racing thoughts.
Proud Dandelion
Build confidence and self-esteem by celebrating daily victories.
Treasure Box
Capture joyful memories to balance mood and boost optimism.
Worry Box
Let go of what’s beyond your control and create emotional calm.
Mindful Meditation
A three-minute mindfulness reset for clarity and focus.
Watermelon Tai Chi
Gentle movement and deep breathing for mind-body balance.
…and more. Quabble offers 18 unique therapist-backed workouts across six key areas of wellness, with new ones added regularly to keep your self-care journey fresh.
Join Quabble Club
Unlock premium features:
• Exclusive workouts and tools
• Unlimited insights with Wellness Radar
• Expanded community support in Bamboo Forest
• Automatic weather and day/night sync
• 300 free hearts each month
Plans: $8.99/month or $49.99/year ($4.16/month).
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled 24 hours before renewal in Account Settings.

Privacy policy: https://quabble.app/privacy
