bluejetty:00027772:ios.name: Jibi Land : Princess Castle
bluejetty:00027772:ios.summary: Jibi Land Princess Castle is a dollhouse game with an open-ended style of play. It allows you to delve into a world of imagination set in a land of magic and fantasies. In this land, you will find many surprises and amazing characters such
bluejetty:00027772:ios.description:
Jibi Land Princess Castle is a dollhouse game with an open-ended style of play. It allows you to delve into a world of imagination set in a land of magic and fantasies. In this land, you will find many surprises and amazing characters such as little princesses, pretty princes, dragons, unicorns, little fairies, and many other cute pets. If you are a fan of dollhouse games, don't miss out!
This is the first game in the Jibi Land series, coming with the enchanted princess castle theme.
How to play:
The way we play is similar to pretend play or playing with a dollhouse. There are no rules to follow. Our game provides a free space where children can let their imagination run wild. Simply select a favorite character and use your imagination to craft your own story.
What will the story in this castle be like next?
You decide !!
Game features:
- 9 fantastic scenes, with tons of secrets and treasure puzzles to surprise you in this castle.
- Many cute characters such as little princess, handsome prince, king, queen, maid, chef, let you create your own story freely.
- More than 100 animal characters for you to raise and take care of such as little unicorn, little fairy, mischievous cat, cute dog.
- Many gorgeous princess dresses to give You dress up princess.
- Dragon eggs and unicorn eggs waiting for you to find and hatch.
- Some pets can grow such as horse, unicorn, dragon. Take care him and watch it grow.
- More than 100 food and beverage menus for you to cook. Let's cook delicious food for princess.
- A magic magnifying glass system that will help you find secret items and solve puzzle.
- Sticker system for you to find and collect over 100 types.
Advice for parents:
This game is designed for children between the ages of 6-12, so they can be played by themselves or with friends. Children under 6 years of age should be accompanied by a parents.
We believe in the power of pretend play It will help develop children's imagination and creativity. So we strive to develop independent space in format dollhouse that is a part for children to play and enjoy with their imagination. And we would appreciate it if parents can take the time to join this game with your child. Because that means our games can play a part in building a good relationship in the your family. 
We hope you enjoy with this game.

bluejetty:00036702:ios.description:
Our PDF Merger app makes it effortless to merge PDF files or combine two or more PDFs into a single, neatly organized document. With its fast merging speed, you can confidently combine PDF files into one file, knowing that all your PDFs will be seamlessly merged without losing any content or quality. Plus, it’s secure, allowing you to keep your merged PDFs safe and private.
In addition, This Merge PDF app offers a complete suite of tools for managing your documents. You can split PDF files into smaller, manageable sections or extract specific pages with ease. The app also lets you lock and unlock PDFs, giving you full control over document access while protecting sensitive information.
How to Use?
Choose PDF files directly from your gallery or create a new text-based PDF. Use the PDF Merger & PDF Combiner to effortlessly join PDF files with just a few taps.
- Key Features of the PDF Merger App:
* Combine PDF Files into One
Easily combine multiple PDF files into one. Import PDFs from your gallery or create a new text-based PDF to merge PDF files seamlessly into a single document.
* Split PDF Files
Need to divide a large document? Use the PDF Splitter feature to break your PDF into smaller sections or extract specific pages to suit your needs.
* Lock and Unlock PDFs
Secure your files by locking them with a password, or remove restrictions to unlock PDFs when needed. Safeguard your sensitive information with ease.
* Delete Pages from PDFs
Remove unnecessary pages from your document effortlessly to streamline your PDF.
* Share Across Platforms
Quickly share your merged PDFs using the PDF Joiner via email, messaging apps, or cloud services.
* Unlimited Merging
Merge as many files as you want, whenever you want, with no limitations.
- Why Choose Us?
The Merge PDF app is built for simplicity and efficiency, making it easy to combine PDF files, manage documents, and save time. Whether you're organizing work files, creating presentations, or consolidating class notes, this app is the perfect tool. Our PDF combiner is ideal for professionals, students, and anyone dealing with multiple PDFs. Plus, it works seamlessly offline or online.
- Who Can Use It?
* Teachers & Educators
Merge lesson plans and materials into a single document with the PDF Merger.
* Business Professionals
Use the app to combine PDF files like reports and presentations into polished documents.
* Legal Professionals
Consolidate contracts and legal filings using the PDF Joiner for secure submissions.
* Real Estate Agents
Create a comprehensive property profile by merging listings and contracts.
* Healthcare Professionals
Organize and share patient records securely with the PDF Combiner app.
* Freelancers
Send invoices, contracts, and project deliverables as organized, professional PDFs using the Join PDF feature.
Take control of your documents today! Download Merge PDF - Combine PDF Files now and simplify your PDF management tasks for free. With its intuitive tools, including PDF Splitter, PDF Joiner, and security features, this app is your all-in-one solution for managing PDFs efficiently.

bluejetty:00016813:ios.description:
World’s healthiest game!
Cure your way through the quirkiest and funniest diseases in My Hospital - the ultimate simulation game where you design, manage and maintain your very own medical centre! 
Create elixirs, farm and harvest your own medical plants and produce cures for hundreds of patients that need your help. It’s a world where Panacea rules and every treatment is available at your fingertips! 
◉ BUILD YOUR HOSPITAL
Construct and manage your own hospital. Build doctor’s offices, diagnostic rooms, the treatment centre and laboratories. Expand and upgrade your hospital and share it with friends! 
◉ CREATE UNIQUE CURES
Farm and harvest plants with healing properties, produce dozens of elixirs, and blend syrups to treat more than 80 funny diseases. Whether it’s a chilli throat condition, frozen hands or slimey lungs, you’ll be sure to find the cure! Unlock new remedies, treatment rooms and new conditions with every level and complete fun challenges!
◉ DECORATE YOUR HOSPITAL

bluejetty:00042551:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Dillons app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Dillons grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Plus Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools

 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Dillons store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.dillons.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.dillons.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Dillons app, you need a Dillons digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Dillons Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Dillons' Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.dillons.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

Suivez toute l’actualité en direct et en continu sur l’application Le Parisien : faits divers, info locale, sport, international, vidéos, podcasts et enquêtes.
Une rédaction de plus de 350 journalistes mobilisés chaque jour sur le terrain.
LE PARISIEN — UNE OFFRE ÉDITORIALE UNIQUE
• Actualité en continu : faits divers, société, pouvoir d'achat, santé, international
• Infos locales en Île-de-France et dans l'Oise
• PSG, football et grands événements sportifs en direct
• Podcasts, vidéos et formats originaux du Parisien
• Culture, séries, cinéma, musique et idées de sorties
L'ESSENTIEL DE VOTRE ACTUALITÉ — EN TEMPS RÉEL
Notifications et journal numérique : accédez rapidement aux informations qui comptent pour vous.
• Notifications personnalisées selon vos centres d'intérêt
• Journal numérique disponible dès 22h30 la veille
PARIS, L'ÎLE-DE-FRANCE ET VOUS
Faits divers, transports, immobilier, environnement, vie pratique : Le Parisien suit l'actualité francilienne avec une couverture terrain dense et ancrée dans le quotidien.
• Actualité locale par département
• Reportages et infos de proximité
• Météo et vie pratique
LE SPORT ET L'ACTUALITÉ DU PSG
Toute l'actualité sportive en direct : résultats, analyses, interviews et coulisses des grandes compétitions nationales et internationales.
• PSG, Paris FC, Ligue 1 et Ligue des Champions
• Équipe de France et compétitions internationales
• Roland-Garros, Tour de France, Jeux olympiques et grands rendez-vous sportifs
• Scores, comptes-rendus et vidéos en temps réel
FAITS DIVERS ET ENQUÊTES
Enquêtes, faits divers et grands récits d'actualité traités par les journalistes du Parisien.
• Décryptages et analyses
• Enquêtes réservées aux abonnés
• Podcasts Code Source, Crime Story et Le Sacre
AU CŒUR DE L'ACTUALITÉ INTERNATIONALE
Guerres, diplomatie, économie mondiale et grands enjeux de société : les événements mondiaux expliqués et suivis en direct.
• Ukraine, Proche-Orient, États-Unis et grands conflits internationaux
• Géopolitique, économie mondiale et politique étrangère
• Analyses, reportages et suivi en direct
LE PARISIEN EN VIDÉO
Retrouvez toute l'actualité en vidéo dans un nouvel espace entièrement dédié.
- Analyses, reportages, décryptages, interviews et podcasts filmés de la rédaction.
- Formats longs, séries exclusives et récits pour vivre l'actualité autrement.
- Politique, sports, économie, société, culture, faits divers et grands événements.
- Suivez les dernières vidéos d'actualité, mises à jour tout au long de la journée.
Accédez à tout moment à l'ensemble de nos contenus vidéo, où que vous soyez.
VOTRE NOUVEL ESPACE JEUX
Mots, logique et défis : chaque jour, de nouveaux défis vous attendent.
- Les mini jeux : Mot du jour, Mini mots croisés, Mini mots fléchés
- Les classiques : Mots croisés, Mots fléchés, Sudoku
- Nos jeux exclusifs : Le mot de l'actu, Dynamics, Alphamo
- Nos jeux rétros : Jeu du serpent, Jeu de briques
- Mais aussi : Mots coupés, Mot mystère, Belote
LE PARISIEN ABONNÉS
Profitez de l'intégralité des contenus du Parisien avec l'abonnement 100% digital et sans engagement.
• Articles exclusifs, enquêtes et analyses
• Lecture sans publicité
• Journal numérique dès 22h30 la veille
• Espace de commentaires abonnés
• Compte unique synchronisé sur l'application et le site
Déjà abonné ? Connectez-vous avec vos identifiants pour accéder à tous les contenus et au journal numérique.
UNE APPLICATION PENSÉE POUR VOUS
• Notifications personnalisées et choix de votre département
• Mode sombre et taille de police ajustable
• Enregistrement de vos articles favoris
L'application évolue en permanence. Une remarque, une suggestion ? Écrivez-nous à mobiles@leparisien.fr
Conditions d'utilisation : leparisien.fr/cgu
Politique de confidentialité : leparisien.fr/politique-confidentialite

bluejetty:00018909:ios.summary:
BETUP is a virtual betting simulator that turns sports prediction into a game, with free bets using virtual Betcoins and no real money involved.
Make your picks, challenge other players, climb the rankings and build your story across Betro
bluejetty:00018909:ios.description:
BETUP is a virtual betting simulator that turns sports prediction into a game, with free bets using virtual Betcoins and no real money involved.
Make your picks, challenge other players, climb the rankings and build your story across Betropolis. Explore real fixtures, realistic odds, Flash Bet, racing and six arcade games—all inside one immersive sports game.
YOUR SPORTS. YOUR PICKS.
Explore 25+ sports and competitions, including football, basketball, tennis, volleyball, ice hockey, baseball, rugby, American football, snooker, badminton and esports.
• Discover live and upcoming fixtures
• Explore leagues, teams and trending matches
• Place quick bets, singles and multi-bets
• Follow scores, results, match history and statistics
• Save your favourite sports, teams, leagues and matches
• Review every pick and track your performance
Build your bets using free virtual currency. No real money is ever wagered or paid out.
MEET ACE, YOUR AI COACH
Ask Ace for match predictions, stats analysis and guidance on your picks. Ace studies form, results and odds to help you plan your next move. AI predictions are for entertainment only.
FLASH BET — INSTANT RESULTS
Think fast and trust your instincts.
Make three predictions while a completed football match unfolds as a lightning-fast simulation. Watch the clock, score, possession and key events, answer under pressure and discover your result in seconds.
PLAY THE STORY OF BETROPOLIS
Your journey is only beginning.
Follow a 15-chapter sports story across the city of Betropolis. Complete betting goals, unlock new chapters, collect stars and earn virtual rewards as you grow into a betting master.
HORSE AND GREYHOUND RACING
Study the field, choose your runners and back your champions across a full selection of racing formats:
• Win and Place
• Exacta and Quinella
• Trifecta
• Head-to-Head
• Favourite vs Field
Explore participant statistics, make ordered selections, follow race results and review your complete racing history—all using virtual Betcoins.
ENTER THE BETUP ARCADE
When you want a quick change of pace, step into an immersive arcade filled with six distinctive games:
• Dice
• Higher or Lower
• War
• Lucky Cells
• Slots
• Roulette
Learn the rules, choose your virtual Betcoin stake and enjoy fast, exciting result moments. Every arcade game uses virtual currency only.
BATTLE OTHER PLAYERS
Turn your sports knowledge into a head-to-head contest.
Create public 1-v-1 Battles, invite a specific player, challenge someone directly from their profile or accept an open challenge. Follow your Battle record and jump straight into a rematch.
CLIMB, COLLECT AND IMPROVE
Every pick adds to your journey:
• Compete on daily, weekly and monthly leaderboards
• Unlock achievements and fill your Trophy Hall
• Analyse detailed profile and Battle statistics
• Track wins, losses, pending bets and winning streaks
• Review your complete balance history
• Claim daily bonuses and campaign rewards
• Study community picks and copy bets you like
PLAY FOR FUN. COMPETE LIKE A PRO.
Whether you are making a quick prediction, building a multi-bet, choosing a racing champion, completing a story mission or challenging another player, BETUP gives every sports fan a new way to play—without risking real money.
DISCLAIMER
• BETUP is a virtual sports betting simulator intended for entertainment
• All bets are placed using virtual Betcoins
• BETUP does not offer real-money betting
• Ace predictions are AI-generated for entertainment only and are not betting advice
• There are no real-money prizes, deposits or withdrawals
• Betcoins have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged
• Optional in-app purchases only add virtual Betcoins or unlock game features
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms & Conditions: https://betup.org/privacy/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://betup.org/privacy/privacy.html

• Explore the infinite depths of an ever-changing dungeon
• Uncover mysteries and find mementos of previous explorers to unlock reality defining secrets

bluejetty:00033058:ios.description:
Timeless classic solitaire is now available on your mobile phone! You can now enjoy the world's best classic single-player card game anytime, anywhere! It can train your brain, help you become a card or patience master, and provide endless entertainment. Try this classic card game and experience the joy it brings!
Faithful players of Classic Solitaire need not worry because we've retained the classic elements of solitaire. Not only can you experience the authentic classic card solitaire, but we've also added new features to enhance your enjoyment of the classic game with a twist.
Our Royal Solitaire introduces a daily challenge feature to your single-player gameplay. This feature records your daily challenges, providing a sense of achievement as you consistently exercise your thinking and mental skills.
Furthermore, Royal Solitaire has invested a lot of effort in card and background design. While playing the game, you'll undoubtedly feel a distinctive and elegant style compared to other products. The card faces are clear and magnificent, ensuring that you won't get tired even after extended gameplay. Additionally, Royal Solitaire includes these features:
1.Ability to choose playing with left hand or right hand
2.Multiple choice backgrounds and cards with different face styles.
3.Click & Draw function for an easier way to play
4.Thoughtful hint function
5.Auto-save incomplete games
6.Unlimited UNDO
Feel free to enjoy the unique atmosphere and design of Royal Solitaire as you immerse yourself in this classic card game!

Introducing "What Would Jesus Do?" - the ultimate spiritual guide and mentor for your daily life

bluejetty:00030768:ios.description:
Team Management. Simplified.
TeamSideline is your all-in-one app for managing and staying connected with your team.
The TeamSideline app gives you seamless access to your teams, with team information automatically populated from your organization, including full roster and game schedules.
Coaches can also create their own team in the App and link to any existing schedule to populate the full schedule.
For each team, you can manage events, view and update your roster, track attendance, chat with team members and stay on top of team activity. You can also access announcements, links, and downloadable resources.
Now with Apple Watch support, you can view upcoming events, schedules, and team communications right from your wrist for even faster access.
Stay tuned! We regularly release new features and improvements based on your feedback.

bluejetty:00040123:ios.description:
Color Lights brings you the world's most entertaining flashlight app, all in one app. A simple but complete tool in your phone with many useful features with music, color and flash.
Color Lights app provide you with many more features synchronizing the camera led flashlight and the screen flashlight turning your phone in a color flashlight ensuring you're enjoying lighting, dancing and listening music.
FEATURES:
* Cool Interface: Stunning graphics with beautiful interface and clean layout make the operation simple, smooth and fast!
* Colorful environment: Simulate a disco ball and another light effects, select your style, switch color mode and host your own personal ambient.
* Optimized: Battery friendly, super bright flashlight and music integration.
* No unnecessary permission, no data collections: Just camera to control the flashlight and microphone to beat to the rhythm of the music. We respect your privacy.
USES:
* Strobe/Blinking Lights: The brightest strobe lights with frequency adjustable can be used in your bike, in your car, to send a warning, to produce a nice effect in when recording a video.
* Animate your music! Color Lights flashlight app can integrate music from Music Streamers(Spotify, Deezer, SoundCloud) and from Music Players and beat to the rhythm of the music! Cool!
* Disco Light: Animate the moments with your friends with disco lights, like a color flashlight create a cool disco light effect that will turn your flash LED on and off with the surrounding sound like graphical equalizer or music visualizer. 
* Mood Light: Selecting slow speed transform your room in a mood lights, using your screen color as a night light displaying color lights of the rainbow that adding ambience and atmosphere to a room. Can help you meditate and relax an even release tension, stress or anxiety.
Have fun!
* Disclaimer: Strobe light can cause epileptic seizures in some people with history of epilepsy. Do not point to the face for long periods.

bluejetty:00037273:ios.description:
This app is developed exclusively for use with the Fujifilm instax WIDE Evo camera. Simply, connect your instax WIDE Evo to this app via Bluetooth and get started. 
●Direct Print
Transfer a photo from your Smartphone to the camera, and print it with the camera using the instax™ Direct Print feature on the App. 
Before printing the photo, you can use the instax WIDE Evo™ App to rotate it, enlarge it or reduce its size.
●Remote Shooting
Control the camera with your Smartphone for remote shooting of photos.
●Save Printed Images
You can transfer photos you had printed with the camera to the instax WIDE Evo™ App. You can also add instax™ frames to your images and save them on your Smartphone.
●Discover Feed
The Discover Feed section in the App allows you to explore other users’ images that were taken with the instax WIDE Evo™ hybrid　instant camera in addition to displaying your own images. You can 
also check out the effects and settings that were used.
●Add to Favorites
You can easily save the film effect settings of works you have printed or that others have used (where such photos are posted on the Discover Feed) to your camera favorites for future use.
[Supported OS]
iOS17.0 or later

bluejetty:00011002:android.name: Stellar Path: Zodiac Echo
bluejetty:00011002:android.summary: Enter a cozy moonlit courtyard and test your focus in a relaxing pair-link puzzle. The board is filled with charming arcane tiles—rings, brooms, scrolls, portals, globes. Your task is simple and satisfying: find two identical tiles and conn
bluejetty:00011002:android.description:
Enter a cozy moonlit courtyard and test your focus in a relaxing pair-link puzzle. The board is filled with charming arcane tiles—rings, brooms, scrolls, portals, globes. Your task is simple and satisfying: find two identical tiles and connect them with a clear path to remove them from the board. Clear all tiles to complete the stage.
How to Play
Find a pair: Tap two identical tiles.
Link rule: The path between them must be clear and can turn up to two times (three straight segments). If the route is blocked, the pair won’t connect.
Remove & progress: Linked tiles vanish, opening new paths and freeing hidden matches.
Goal: Clear every tile to finish the level.
Helpful Tools
Hint: Reveal a connectable pair when you’re stuck.
Shuffle/Refresh: Rearrange remaining tiles to surface new routes.
Special tiles: Some golden or glowing tiles may act as wilds or grant bonuses—use them wisely.
What Makes It Fun
Zen flow: Soft visuals, gentle effects, and quick rounds perfect for short breaks.
Smart satisfaction: Each match opens corridors for the next—planning creates lovely chains.
Steady challenge: Compact early boards grow into intricate puzzles that reward observation.

bluejetty:00022357:ios.description:
The Translate Anything app is your best choice for translating any type of text, speech, photos, or objects in more than 50 worldwide languages. 
We offer multiple input methods for your words or objects that need translations such as: 
 - TYPING or SPEAKING: Translate bilingual conversations on the fly 
 - PHOTOS: Take or import photos containing words or objects for the most accurate translations 
 - LIVE TRANSLATIONS: Translate text or objects instantly by just pointing the camera where needed 
 - OBJECT DETECTION: Use your photos and camera to take advantage of our cutting-edge objects detection system and receive words within objects translated for you immediately 
You don't need to worry anymore about any kind of conversation in any language anywhere across the globe. We translate languages immediately and accurately! 
We created the app in order for it to be very easy to use and to solve all your needs. You will only need to focus on the main subjects of your conversations from now on and not worry about any stressful translations. 
Permissions Requested: 
 - Microphone for speach translations 
 - Camera and Photo Gallery for translating text and objects from your pictures 
Download the Translate Anything app now and enjoy the powerful features that make conversing with friends, family and coworkers across the globe easy and fun! Take the stress out of translating anything and enjoy your conversations! 
---------------------------------------------- 
The Translate Anything App Premium Subscription 
---------------------------------------------- 
Join the "Translate Anything App Premium Features Club” to get: 
 - Unlimited translations in more than 100 languages 
 - No ads 
The Translate Anything app has different subscription plans. 
Subscription payments are charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period or trial. Subscriptions starting with a trial automatically renew for the indicated price after the trial period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the trial period. 
Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase ("Settings" -> "iTunes & App Store" -> "Apple ID" and select "Subscriptions")

bluejetty:00026068:ios.name: Find Bluetooth: BLE Scanner
bluejetty:00026068:ios.summary:
Lost your AirPods, headphones, or another Bluetooth device? Find it fast with a live BLE radar, signal strength, and distance hints—before the battery runs out.
Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices in seconds and walk toward the
bluejetty:00026068:ios.description:
Lost your AirPods, headphones, or another Bluetooth device? Find it fast with a live BLE radar, signal strength, and distance hints—before the battery runs out.
Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices in seconds and walk toward the strongest signal.
HOW TO USE
1. Open the app and scan for nearby BLE devices.
2. Select the device you want to find from the list.
3. Move slowly while watching the radar, signal strength, and estimated distance.
4. When you are within a few meters, look around—your device is close.
KEY FEATURES
• Live scan for nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices
• Radar view with signal strength and distance estimates
• Fast guidance to help you locate lost earbuds, headphones, speakers, watches, and more
• Clean, modern interface designed for quick recovery
COMPATIBLE DEVICES
Works with many BLE devices that are powered on and advertising, including:
• Wireless earbuds and AirPods
• Bluetooth headphones and headsets
• Portable Bluetooth speakers
• Smartwatches and fitness wearables
• AirTag and other BLE accessories
IMPORTANT
Your device must be turned on and broadcasting a Bluetooth signal to appear. Classic Bluetooth-only devices may not be detectable.
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renew in your App Store account settings.
Terms: https://sunshine-dev.com/?page_id=98
Privacy Policy: https://sunshinesoftwarelabs.com/

bluejetty:00034119:ios.description:
AI Cleanup for Your iPhone
Clean Up Your iPhone with AI Precision!
AI Cleanup is the ultimate cleaning companion for your iPhone, designed to optimize your device's performance and storage. With a suite of powerful features, it helps you manage and organize your photos, videos, contacts, calendar events, and more with ease. Say goodbye to clutter and hello to a smoother, faster iPhone experience.
Key Features:
Photo and Video Cleaning: Automatically detect and remove duplicate or similar photos and videos to free up valuable storage space. Organize your media effortlessly and keep only the best moments.
Contacts Cleaning: Keep your contacts list tidy by merging duplicates and removing outdated or unnecessary entries. Ensure your address book is always up-to-date and easy to navigate.
Compress Photo and Video: Reduce the file size of your photos and videos without compromising on quality. Save space and share media faster, whether you’re sending it via email or social media.
Calendar Cleaning: Clean up old or redundant calendar events to streamline your schedule. Focus on what’s important with a clutter-free calendar.
Secret Folder: Protect your private photos, videos, and documents with a secure, password-protected folder. Keep your sensitive information safe and accessible only to you.
Battery Charge Animations: Enjoy visually appealing battery charge animations while your iPhone powers up. Choose from a variety of animations to make charging fun and engaging.
PLEASE NOTE:
Our app offers the following premium subscription options:
1 week premium subscription (auto-renew, paid weekly) = $ 6.99
1 year premium subscription (auto-renew, paid yearly) = $ 39.99
If you decide to purchase premium features, your subscription will be charged to your Apple account. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each subscription term, unless you turn off auto-renewal. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase, but must do so within 24 hours before the end of your current subscription term to avoid renewal. If you don’t purchase premium fucntions you can continue to use app for free

bluejetty:00038888:ios.description:
카카오페이 하나로
모두가 금융할 수 있도록
“마음 놓고 금융하다, 카카오페이”
카카오페이, 이렇게 써보세요
■ 결제
 - 어느 탭에 있든 '결제' 탭 두 번 누르면 결제 준비 끝
 - 결제혜택도 맞춤으로, 가까운 혜택까지 다 챙겨서 결제
 - 멤버십 적립, 만료 가까워진 쿠폰도, 알고 있으면 유용한 결제 팁까지 한 번에 확인하고 결제
 - 제로페이도 되니까! 어디서나 카카오페이로 결제
 - 위젯만 있다면 잠금 화면에서도 바로 결제
 - 손목만 내밀면 끝! 애플워치로 결제
 - 생체 인증으로 빠르고 편하게 결제, 바코드와 QR코드로 장소 제한 없이 결제
■ 자산
 - 송금, 결제, 카드, 계좌, 보험, 대출, 투자까지 돈 쓸 일 많은 요즘, 
 번거로운 공인인증서 없이 가능한 자산관리
■ 증권
 - 투자에 필요한 맞춤 정보 제공, 다양하고 빠른 주식 주문 경험
 - 간편하게 시작하고 자동으로 수익을 쌓는 주식 모으기
 - 세액공제도 받고 투자 수익도 내는 연금저축
 - 거스름돈도 모으면 태산! 부담없이 시작하는 펀드 동전모으기
■ 보험
 - 가입한 모든 보험, 카카오페이에서 가입 내역부터 보장 내용까지 간편 관리 
 - 복잡한 서류 제출 없이, 간편한 병원비 청구
 - 자동차보험 고민 끝! 10개 보험사 비교로 내 차에 꼭 맞는 자동차보험 찾기
 - 카카오페이에서만 경험 할 수 있는 특별한 보험상품도 만나보세요
■ 혜택
 - 출석체크, 퀴즈타임, 매일모으기, 만보기 등 재미있는 혜택 서비스로 현금처럼 사용할 수 있는 페이포인트를 매일! 쉽게! 모아보세요.
■ 송금
 - 계좌번호 몰라도, 카톡 친구가 아니어도 바로 송금할 수 있는 내 주변 송금
 - 모임 회비, 용돈, 경조사비 등 깜박하지 않고 원하는 주기와 날짜에 예약 송금, 자동 이체
 - 카톡 친구에게 보낼 때, 카카오페이에 등록한 내 계좌로 보낼 때 무료로 송금
■ 안심하고 사용하세요
 - 핀테크 업계 최초, 금융보안원 정보보호 개인 정보 관리체계(ISMS-P) 통합 인증
 - 빅데이터・AI 기반 이상거래 감지시스템(FDS) 구축
■ 꼭 필요한 권한만 확인해요
 - 정보통신망법 제22조의 2(접근 권한에 대한 동의)에 따라 아래와 같이 카카오페이 앱 사용 시 필요한 접근 권한을 안내해드려요.
선택 권한 (선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스 사용이 가능해요)
 - 알림: 서비스 이용 시 필수 알림 수신
 - 카메라 / 마이크: 송금 및 결제 시 코드 스캔 또는 촬영 등
 - 위치: 송금 및 결제 시 위치 확인
 - 사진: QR 코드 이미지 저장
 - Face ID: 카카오페이 비밀번호 및 화면잠금 비밀번호 입력을 대체
 - 동작 및 피트니스: 만보기 걸음수 확인
 - 블루투스/로컬네트워크: 송금 가능한 주변인 탐색
 * 선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스 사용이 가능해요.
■ 당신을 위해 열려있어요
 - 카카오페이 고객센터 챗봇(카카오톡): 24시간, 365일 상시
 - 상담사 연결: 평일 9시~17시 30분
 - 고객센터: 1644-7405 (평일 9시~18시)
 - 분실 및 도용신고: 1833-7483 (24시간)

bluejetty:00022072:ios.description:
Enjoy saving time and feeling peace of mind with the award-winning Pikmykid Parent App which makes school arrivals and dismissals safe and easy!
Stay fully in control of your children's pickup schedule and make any plan changes with just a few clicks
Should an emergency occur, you have the peace of mind knowing that your kids are safe by receiving communication in real time during reunifications.
With the Pikmykid Parent App, you’ll spend less time waiting in pick-up lines and being put on-hold on the telephone, and instead have everything you need for a safe and stress-free experience daily.
The Pikmykid Parent app gives you a simpler way to manage your kid’s school transportation, pickup delegation, and daily and emergency communications.
“Pikmykid is an extremely user-friendly and simple solution that provides a safe, quick pickup at school without the chaos of after school traffic. Love it!” 
Richard O., Parent
HOW PIKMYKID HELPS
> Take Stress Out of the Picture
You should be empowered with a tool that makes coordinating your kids’ transportation plans so easy, you never have to call the front office again. 
> Experience Stellar Communication
As you make dismissal changes, school staff can see exactly when to release your student, who to release them to, and can notify you they’re been safely dismissed.
> Stop Wasting Time & Enjoy Rest
With smooth dismissals, parents spend on average 33-50% less time in the car line. This means you’ll have more time to spend with your kids outside of school.
> Feel Safer During the School Day
With a platform that helps prevent accidents, stranger danger, custody battles, and exposure to harsh weather, you can feel safer sending your kids to school.
HOW IT WORKS
> Manage It All From One Place
Whether you need to communicate that your kid will be going home with a friend, or need to schedule an early release for a doctor’s appointment, Pikmykid lets you manage the process simply. 
> Make Dismissal Changes
You no longer need to call the front office to make dismissal changes. Instead you can instantly update how and with whom your kid will go home, and even schedule future carpools.
> Announce Your Arrival
You’ll be able to announce your arrival on the app so the teacher knows to send out your kid. The car line moves quickly and staff can verify the right person is picking up your kid as well.
> Receive Dismissal Notifications
Once dismissed, you’ll receive a notification on your app letting you know. You can also receive info from school like when a bus is running late or about an upcoming field trip.
HOW IT WORKS TO MAKE SCHOOL SAFER
> During Dismissal Your School Is Able To:
Verify pickup permissions.
Timestamp each student’s dismissal.
Maintain early dismissal changes.
Know with whom students are meant to go with.
Minimize custody issues.
Communicate consistently and clearly.
Maintain accurate attendance records.
> During an Emergency You Can:
Get notified quickly about an emergency.
Receive instructions on what to do & where to go.
Know when your kid is dismissed & to whom.
Reunite quickly during extreme emergencies.
HOW PIKMYKID SUPPORTS YOU
> World-Class Support
> Reliable Technology
> Based on Safety Best Practices
> Prioritizing Student Privacy
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
“The best part of Pikmykid is you don’t have to make the annoying phone calls or leave your meetings to let them know that the transportation has changed. You go on your app, make the change, and it’s done.” 
Jade G., Parent
“The app is great! It’s simple to use and it really streamlines the school pickup process. I’m most impressed with Pikmykid’s customer service! They respond quickly and in a very personalized manner.” 
Sue A., Parent

listings.description:
Enjoy saving time and feeling peace of mind with the award-winning Pikmykid Parent App which makes school arrivals and dismissals safe and easy!

Stay fully in control of your children's pickup schedule and make any plan changes with just a few clicks

Should an emergency occur, you have the peace of mind knowing that your kids are safe by receiving communication in real time during reunifications.

With the Pikmykid Parent App, you’ll spend less time waiting in pick-up lines and being put on-hold on the telephone, and instead have everything you need for a safe and stress-free experience daily.


The Pikmykid Parent app gives you a simpler way to manage your kid’s school transportation, pickup delegation, and daily and emergency communications.

“Pikmykid is an extremely user-friendly and simple solution that provides a safe, quick pickup at school without the chaos of after school traffic. Love it!” 
Richard O., Parent


HOW PIKMYKID HELPS

> Take Stress Out of the Picture
You should be empowered with a tool that makes coordinating your kids’ transportation plans so easy, you never have to call the front office again. 


> Experience Stellar Communication
As you make dismissal changes, school staff can see exactly when to release your student, who to release them to, and can notify you they’re been safely dismissed.

> Stop Wasting Time & Enjoy Rest
With smooth dismissals, parents spend on average 33-50% less time in the car line. This means you’ll have more time to spend with your kids outside of school.

> Feel Safer During the School Day
With a platform that helps prevent accidents, stranger danger, custody battles, and exposure to harsh weather, you can feel safer sending your kids to school.

HOW IT WORKS

> Manage It All From One Place
Whether you need to communicate that your kid will be going home with a friend, or need to schedule an early release for a doctor’s appointment, Pikmykid lets you manage the process simply. 


> Make Dismissal Changes
You no longer need to call the front office to make dismissal changes. Instead you can instantly update how and with whom your kid will go home, and even schedule future carpools.

> Announce Your Arrival
You’ll be able to announce your arrival on the app so the teacher knows to send out your kid. The car line moves quickly and staff can verify the right person is picking up your kid as well.

> Receive Dismissal Notifications
Once dismissed, you’ll receive a notification on your app letting you know. You can also receive info from school like when a bus is running late or about an upcoming field trip.

HOW IT WORKS TO MAKE SCHOOL SAFER

> During Dismissal Your School Is Able To:
Verify pickup permissions.
Timestamp each student’s dismissal.
Maintain early dismissal changes.
Know with whom students are meant to go with.
Minimize custody issues.
Communicate consistently and clearly.
Maintain accurate attendance records.


> During an Emergency You Can:
Get notified quickly about an emergency.
Receive instructions on what to do & where to go.
Know when your kid is dismissed & to whom.
Reunite quickly during extreme emergencies.

HOW PIKMYKID SUPPORTS YOU

> World-Class Support
> Reliable Technology
> Based on Safety Best Practices
> Prioritizing Student Privacy

TRUSTED BY MILLIONS

“The best part of Pikmykid is you don’t have to make the annoying phone calls or leave your meetings to let them know that the transportation has changed. You go on your app, make the change, and it’s done.” 
Jade G., Parent

“The app is great! It’s simple to use and it really streamlines the school pickup process. I’m most impressed with Pikmykid’s customer service! They respond quickly and in a very personalized manner.” 
Sue A., Parent

Match. Chat. Play. 
Plink – the revolutionary app for gamers. 
Forget about playing alone - find your perfect teammate, influence game history and plunge into a global game community.
Want to improve your gamerscore?

bluejetty:00023556:ios.description:
A simple, flexible and private diary.
Keeping a journal helps in many ways. You can be more aware of your feelings and thoughts, keep track of your mood, dreams or experiences. Many influencing people love keeping a diary since it helps in so many ways!
-- “People who keep journals have life twice.” -- Jessamyn West
We've made this app as simple to use as possible. Everything is easy to discover and we'll guide you through the most advanced features. Our users love a simple and polished experience and that's what we give them.
 -- “In the journal I am at ease.” -- Anais Nin
We give you all the flexibility you need. We won't tie you to any strict structure or force you to track anything you don't care about. You can add entries to the diary, like a mindfulness session or an area to list reasons for gratitude. You may even configure the diary as a travel journal or a dreams journal! That's easy to setup too: the only limit is your imagination.
-- “I can shake off everything as I write; my sorrows disappear, my courage is reborn.” -- Anne Frank
Your diary should be as private as you want. We do not upload your data anywhere, we don't track you and we value your privacy. And you get even more: we included a system to lock the app, so that no intruder can see your diary without your consent. Your diary is yours, private and secure.
-- “Whether you’re keeping a journal or writing as a meditation, it’s the same thing. What’s important is you’re having a relationship with your mind.” -- Natalie Goldberg
You are using an advanced device, so we're providing advanced and easy to use features. Like a cute mood tracking system. Or a way to import pictures in your journal. But also a calendar to navigate your memories... You can feel at ease, with a simple and familiar diary in your hands but also feel the power of the new tech you are using. We hope you will enjoy the balance.
-- “I don’t journal to ‘be productive.’ I don’t do it to find great ideas or to put down prose I can later publish. The pages aren’t intended for anyone but me. It’s the most cost-effective therapy I’ve ever found.” -- Tim Ferriss
Download and try it, you will not regret it!
---

apple-macos:1237892621.description:
MySudo is the original all-in-one privacy app that lets you protect your information, secure your chat, and organize your life.
PROTECT YOUR INFORMATION with secure digital identities called Sudos, each with its own phone, email, handle, private browser, and virtual card. Anywhere you’d normally use your personal phone number, email or credit card, use your Sudo ones instead. Sign up for deals and discounts, book rental cars and hotel rooms, pay for concerts or a coffee—all without giving away your personal information. 
SECURE YOUR CHAT with end-to-end encrypted calls, texts and emails between MySudo users via your Sudo handle—or communicate standard outside the app with everyone else. Your Sudo phone and email work just like your personal ones AND they protect you from spam and scams. 
ORGANIZE YOUR LIFE with multiple Sudo digital identities, each with a different purpose. Depending on your plan, you can have up to 9 Sudos, so you can shop with a Sudo, date with a Sudo, order food with a Sudo, sell secondhand stuff with a Sudo, live with a Sudo. What happens in a Sudo stays in the Sudo, so your information is safe and organized. 
WHAT’S IN A SUDO?
 1 email address – for end-to-end encrypted emails between app users, and standard email with everyone else
 1 handle – for end-to-end encrypted messages and video, voice and group calls between app users
 1 private browser – for searching the internet without ads and tracking
 1 phone number (optional)* – for end-to-end encrypted messaging and video, voice and group calls between app users, and standard connections with everyone else; customizable and mutable
 1 virtual card (optional)* – for protecting your personal info and your money, like a proxy for your credit or debit card or bank account
*Phone numbers and virtual cards only available on a paid plan. Phone numbers available for US, CA and UK only. Virtual cards for US only.
SELECT THE PAID PLAN THAT’S RIGHT FOR YOU
SudoGo – the budget plan with a phone number
 1 phone number
 3 Sudos
 100 messages a month
 30 mins talk time a month
 3 GB space
SudoPro – the great value plan with more of everything
 3 phone numbers
 3 Sudos
 300 messages a month
 200 mins talk time a month
 5 GB space
SudoMax – the most Sudos for the most options
 9 phone numbers
 9 Sudos
 Unlimited messages
 Unlimited calls
 15 GB space
PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY, EVEN WITH US
 We won’t ask for your email or phone number to create an account.
 You don’t need a registration login or password to use the app. Access is protected by a key that never leaves your device. 
 We’ll only ask for personal information for virtual cards, and UK phone numbers, when a one-time identity verification is required.
LEVEL UP YOUR MYSUDO EXPERIENCE
MySudo all-in-one privacy app is part of the MySudo app family:
 Bring your Sudos to your desktop with MySudo Desktop.
 Autofill your Sudo details directly from your web browser with MySudo Browser Extension.
 Get a VPN that’s actually private with MySudo VPN.
 Reclaim your personal info from the companies that store and sell it with RECLAIM.

apple-itunes:6749851029.name: Goods Hunt - Shopping Hole
apple-itunes:6749851029.description:
Welcome to Goods Hunt!
A physics-based puzzle where your shopping cart transforms into an absorbing collector. Navigate supermarket aisles, gather everyday items, and watch them stack infinitely high before collapsing spectacularly. Seasonal events like Halloween bring spooky collectibles and festive challenges to your shopping trips.
INFINITELY SATISFYING
Complete your shopping list and trigger a breathtaking collapse animation. Realistic physics makes each tower crumble uniquely. 
YOUR HOLE CART SIZE UP GRADUALLY 
Start with a small absorption hole. Eat small items first to expand your hole size. The bigger you grow, the larger items you can hunt. This creates natural progression where impossible items become achievable as you progress. Strategic thinking determines collection order.
THEMED COLLECTIONS
Unlock cup collections as you progress through levels. Discover themes like Fruits, Bakery, Aquatic, Candy Land, Beverages, and more. Each theme features multiple cups to collect during gameplay. Complete entire collections to earn exclusive rewards including coins, boosters, and special bonuses.
CONTINUOUS EVENTS
- Key Hunt challenges you to collect golden keys scattered throughout levels. Unlock treasure chests containing rare items and exclusive cups. 
- Chugging Treasure brings limited-time collectible milk appearing in each level.
- Star Contest offers weekly competition on global leaderboards where top performers earn legendary recognition. 
- Cloud Quest provides themed challenge chains - complete quests to unlock entire collection sets instantly.
- Halloween fills the aisles with spooky collectible objects to hunt, plus a 7-day challenge with fresh goals to complete.
We regularly add new events and exclusive content keeping gameplay fresh.
YOUR SUPERMARKET ADVENTURE
Familiar aisles, recognizable products, everyday items you see in the supermarket - but with an addictive twist and cute design.
The most satisfying feeling comes when items stack infinitely high inside your cart. It's the comforting familiarity of shopping combined with incredibly rewarding gameplay.
PROGRESSION
Unlock themes at level milestones, we have various collections for you to discover. Collect boosters through gameplay and events - Magnet attracts nearby items automatically, Freeze Time pauses countdowns for planning, Compass reveals hidden shopping list items.
FAMILIAR SUPERMARKET ITEMS
Recognizable supermarket products create immediate connection. Everyday goods from real shopping trips make collecting fun and relaxing. This familiarity makes the experience oddly satisfying.
IDEAL FOR
Collection completionists hunting themed sets. Event participants enjoying rotating challenges. Casual players seeking relaxing puzzles. Competitive players climbing leaderboards. Anyone appreciating visual and audio feedback.
HOW TO PLAY
Drag the hole through aisles absorbing goods strategically. Eat small items to increase size. Complete objectives before time expires. Gather cups during gameplay. Finish collections for rewards.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at support@lihuhugames.com. 
Download Goods Hunt and start your infinite stacking adventure today!
